  "translation_zh": "The Open Group 是一个全球性联盟，拥有 900 多个会员（memberships）。它通过技术标准与开源倡议，在多元成员之间培育协作、包容与相互尊重的文化，帮助各组织实现业务目标。其成员涵盖多个行业的客户、系统与解决方案供应商、工具厂商、集成商、学术界与咨询顾问。\n\nThe Open Group 的使命是推动实现**无边界信息流**（Boundaryless Information Flow™），途径包括：\n\n- 与客户合作，捕捉、理解并应对当前及新兴需求，制定政策并分享最佳实践；\n- 与供应商、联盟及标准组织合作，凝聚共识、促进互操作，推动规范与开源技术的演进与整合；\n- 提供全面的服务组合，提升联盟的运营效率；\n- 开发并运营业界领先的认证服务，鼓励采购通过认证的产品。\n\n有关 The Open Group 的更多信息，请访问 www.opengroup.org。\n\nThe Open Group 出版各类技术文档，多数聚焦于标准与指南的制定，也包括白皮书、技术研究、认证与测试文档以及商业类出版物。完整详情与目录请参见 www.opengroup.org/library。",

text:
关于 TOGAF 系列指南
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:series-guides",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0009",
  "section_number": null,
  "title_en": "About the TOGAF® Series Guides",

  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "newly-translated-source-context",
  "pdf_pages": [
    9
  ],
  "translation_zh": "TOGAF® 系列指南说明如何使用 TOGAF 标准，以及如何裁剪以满足具体需要。\n\n系列指南预期是 TOGAF 标准中发展最快的部分，定位为标准的指导部分。TOGAF 基础内容预期保持长期稳定，而使用指导可针对行业、架构风格、用途与问题。例如，扩展企业转型所需的利益相关者、关注点、视图与支撑模型，可能与内部 IT 环境迁移到云所需内容显著不同；两者都使用 ADM，都从架构愿景开始，开发目标架构，并走向实施与迁移计划。TOGAF 基础内容是跨行业、领域和风格的必要支架。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0009:c000",
      "pdf_page": 9,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "About the TOGAF® Series Guides",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0009:b001"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        34.434,
        332.31,
        59.22

    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0009:c001",
      "pdf_page": 9,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The TOGAF® Series Guides contain guidance on how to use the TOGAF Standard and how to adapt it to fulfill specific needs.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0009:b002",
        "G152:p0009:b003",
        "G152:p0009:b004"
      ],
      "bbox": [

        563.76,
        99.03
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0009:c002",
      "pdf_page": 9,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The TOGAF® Series Guides are expected to be the most rapidly developing part of the TOGAF® Standard and are positioned as the guidance part of the standard. While the TOGAF Fundamental Content is expected to be long-lived and stable, guidance on the use of the TOGAF Standard can be industry, architectural style, purpose, and problem-specific.   "terminology_zh": [
    {
      "term_en": "Risk",
      "preferred_zh": "风险",
      "distinction_zh": "不确定性对目标的影响，包括正负结果；不等同单一威胁或损失事件。"
    },
    {
      "term_en": "Security Policy / Security Strategy / Security Principle",
      "preferred_zh": "安全政策 / 安全战略 / 安全原则",
      "distinction_zh": "政策表达战略并分配责任；原则指导决策。"
    },
    {
      "term_en": "Security Objective / Security Requirement / Security Target",
      "preferred_zh": "安全目标 / 安全需求 / 安全目标值",
      "distinction_zh": "期望状态、架构要求、绩效阈值或可容忍偏差分别记录。"
    },
    {
      "term_en": "Business Attribute Profile",
      "preferred_zh": "业务属性画像",
      "distinction_zh": "包含按业务情境定义的属性、指标和目标，不只是图5-1词汇列表。"
    },
    {
      "term_en": "Risk Appetite / Risk Tolerance",
      "preferred_zh": "风险偏好 / 风险容忍",
      "distinction_zh": "按具体原段关系保留，不把本指南局部联系强制扩展到所有外部风险模型。"
    },
    {
      "term_en": "Security Services Catalog / Control Framework",
      "preferred_zh": "安全服务目录 / 控制框架",
      "distinction_zh": "前者描述提供保护的服务构建块及运营信息，后者包含要求或强制措施。"
    },
    {
      "term_en": "regression planning (migration)",
      "preferred_zh": "回退规划（迁移语境）",
      "distinction_zh": "原文目的为reverse out failed migration，不仅是回归测试。"
    }
  ],

  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",

    13,
    14
  ],
  "translation_zh": "企业架构（包括安全架构）的核心，是让业务系统与支撑信息系统有效、高效地对齐以实现业务目标（系统是流程、人员与技术的组合）。企业架构的重要质量属性之一，是信息安全及其管理方式。长期以来，信息安全被视为独立学科，与业务流程和企业架构相隔离。\n\n**安全架构**是由组织、概念、逻辑与物理组件构成的结构，这些组件以连贯方式交互，以实现并维持受管理的风险与安全（或信息安全）状态。它既是受保护行为（secure）、安全行为（safe）、韧性行为（resilient）与可靠行为（reliable）的驱动因素与使能因素，也是应对全企业各风险领域的驱动因素与使能因素。\n\n然而，企业安全架构并非孤立存在。作为企业的一部分，它建立在企业架构中已有的企业信息之上，并产出影响企业架构的信息。这就是安全架构与企业架构紧密整合之所以有益的原因：与事后“外挂”安全相比，一次做对最终可节省成本并提升有效性。为此，安全架构师与企业架构师需要使用共同语言。本指南引入这种语言，说明如何把安全与风险融入企业架构，为使用 TOGAF® 标准 [C220] 开发企业架构的安全从业者与企业架构师提供指导。\n\n图 1-1 概括了本指南：展示企业架构与企业安全架构如何相关，突出信息安全管理（ISM）与企业风险管理（ERM）中使用的核心安全与风险概念。这些概念列于中间列，构成补充并增强 TOGAF 标准的一组基础概念；图中带下划线的概念是 ISM 或 ERM 引入 TOGAF 框架的新增内容。\n\n图 1-1：核心安全与风险概念及其在 TOGAF ADM 中的位置。原图、图元与当前关系解释读取本节 structured_references。",

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Enterprise Architecture (including Security Architecture) is all about aligning business systems and supporting information systems to realize business goals in an effective and efficient manner (systems being the combination of processes, people, and technology). One of the important quality aspects of an Enterprise Architecture is information security and the way this can be managed. For too long, information security has been considered a separate discipline, isolated from the business processes and Enterprise Architecture.",

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "A Security Architecture is a structure of organizational, conceptual, logical, and physical components that interact in a coherent fashion in order to achieve and maintain a state of managed risk and security (or information security). It is both a driver and enabler of secure, safe, resilient, and reliable behavior, as well as for addressing risk areas throughout the enterprise.",

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "However, an Enterprise Security Architecture does not exist in isolation. As part of the enterprise, it builds on enterprise information that is already available in the Enterprise Architecture, and it produces information that influences the Enterprise Architecture. This is why a close integration of Security Architecture in the Enterprise Architecture is beneficial. In the end, doing it right the first time saves costs and increases effectiveness compared to bolting on security afterwards. To achieve this, Security Architects and Enterprise Architects need to speak the same language. That language is introduced in this Guide, which describes how to integrate security and risk into an Enterprise Architecture. It provides guidance for both security practitioners and Enterprise Architects working with the TOGAF® Standard, a standard of The Open Group [C220], to develop an Enterprise Architecture.",

text:
1.1 本指南如何支持 TOGAF 标准？
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:1.1",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0015",
  "section_number": "1.1",
  "title_en": "1.1. How does this Guide Support the TOGAF Standard?",
  "title_zh": "1.1 本指南如何支持 TOGAF 标准？",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    14
  ],
  "translation_zh": "这些新内容把当前 TOGAF 标准中的安全活动提升到更高的概念层次，目标是说明如何裁剪 TOGAF 方法与框架，以利用现有企业安全架构妥善处理安全与风险。\n\n该方法以业务为驱动，支持两个过程的整合：ISM 与 ERM。这种过程导向将改善对 TOGAF 架构开发方法（ADM）各阶段安全概念与活动的理解；业务导向则有助于论证安全组件的合理性。\n\n该方法预见还需要开发大量面向安全从业者的补充指导，本指南为此奠定基础；通过共同的基础，将形成内部一致且实用的工作方式。",

    {

      "pdf_page": 14,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,

      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "This new content takes the security activities in the current TOGAF Standard [C220] to a higher conceptual level. The goal of this approach is to explain how the TOGAF method and framework can be tailored to make use of an existing Enterprise Security Architecture in order to address security and risk properly.",

        "G152:p0014:b003",

      "pdf_page": 14,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "This approach is business-driven and supports the integration of two processes: ISM and ERM. This process orientation will improve understanding of the security concepts and activities at different phases through the TOGAF Architecture Development Method (ADM). The business orientation will contribute to justification of the security components.",

        "G152:p0014:b007",

        "G152:p0014:b009",
        "G152:p0014:b010"

      "pdf_page": 14,
      "content_index_zero_based": 4,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "In this approach, it is foreseen that a lot of additional security practitioner guidance needs to be developed. This Guide provides the basis for that work. By using a common foundation this will deliver an internally consistent and practical way of working.",

text:
1.2 风险管理呢？
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:1.2",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0016",
  "section_number": "1.2",
  "title_en": "1.2. What about Risk Management?",
  "title_zh": "1.2 风险管理呢？",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    14,
    15
  ],
  "translation_zh": "TOGAF 标准中的风险管理主要聚焦**架构项目风险**，这只是风险的一种。本指南作为企业安全架构一部分呈现的 ERM 范围要广得多，还包括业务、系统、信息、项目、隐私、合规与组织变革等风险类别。\n\n本指南描述 ERM 的更广泛概念及其如何融入 TOGAF 标准，特别聚焦**运营风险**的全部方面——企业在日常运营中面临的、由企业架构工作所产出的运营能力所引致的风险。其意图是：通过更加关注企业架构工作产品下游的运营风险，提升这些工作产品的效用、质量与有效性。\n\n企业安全架构对风险持平衡观点：把负面后果控制在可接受水平，同时最大化利用正向机会。业务驱动方法对安全架构至关重要：业务驱动为风险评估提供语境，界定是否需要遵循某控制框架，并为安全措施的必要性提供论证。\n\n本指南明确在最佳实践 ERM 的语境中审视风险，面向期望采用最佳实践，并愿意仔细阅读和考量专业用语的从业者。与其他专业一样，风险管理专业也不断演进。最佳实践 ERM 的核心是对“风险”的精确定义。在此前约十五年中，风险管理专业的风险定义已从思想引领、领先实践发展为成熟的最佳实践。该定义已纳入 ISO 31000:2009 [ISO 31000] 等主流国际风险管理标准、最佳实践指南和行业指南，例如全球风险管理专业人士协会（GARP）的金融风险管理师认证。\n\n“风险”的日常通行定义与风险管理专业定义存在差别。风险管理专业将风险定义为“不确定性对业务目标实现的影响”。许多信息安全从业者可能不习惯这一定义：在其学科中，风险通常与威胁绑定，被视为负面属性。\n\n由于本指南面向 TOGAF 企业架构框架的核心概念，因此采用 ISO 31000:2009 的风险定义。这并不妨碍后续从业指导仅使用风险的较窄负面含义，例如在信息安全风险管理领域，不确定性通常总是对应负面结果。",

text:
1.3 控制清单在哪里？
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:1.3",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0017",
  "section_number": "1.3",
  "title_en": "1.3. Where is the Controls Checklist?",
  "title_zh": "1.3 控制清单在哪里？",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    15,
    16
  ],
  "translation_zh": "首先，整合安全并不是从清单中挑选控制措施。我们主张对安全采取整体方法，从而交付一个可信、稳健、可靠、安全且风险得到管理的架构。为此，企业安全架构确保 ADM 与 ISM、ERM 过程之间实现紧密协作。因此，本指南中的大多数安全概念都指向妥善建立安全所需的事项。\n\n然而，设计运营安全同样是架构的一部分。在架构语境中，安全控制被打包为安全服务。安全服务可视为一个架构构建块（ABB）。在 TOGAF 标准中，ABB 捕获既指导又引导解决方案构建块（SBB）开发的架构需求。这适用于 TOGAF 的全部四个领域架构：业务、数据、应用与技术。同理，安全服务捕获安全需求，并指导子服务与组件的开发。\n\n安全服务的示例包括：\n\n- 身份与访问管理（Identity & Access Management）\n- 连续性管理（Continuity Management）\n- 安全情报（Security Intelligence）\n- 数字取证（Digital Forensics）\n- 审计（Audit）\n- 网络监控（Network Monitoring）\n- 合规管理（Compliance Management）\n- 培训与意识计划（Training & Awareness Programs）等\n\n安全服务位于 SABSA 架构框架的逻辑层，该逻辑层在 TOGAF ADM 的阶段 C（信息系统架构）中开发。安全服务目录（Security Services Catalog）提供这些安全服务的实际描述。\n\n为支持安全从业者实际设计并使用安全服务，需要安全服务目录。对安全架构师而言，安全服务目录是一个登记册，支持用安全控制填充 SABSA 架构框架的逻辑层。与包含要求的现有控制框架不同，安全服务目录描述真正提供保护的安全构建块。这种架构方法使信息安全能够顺畅地融入企业架构。\n\n这种标准化方法有助于安全管理组织的专业化，并促进更高效、更具成本效益的工作方式。安全服务目录的主要优势之一是，它为安全管理领域提供共同的术语与参考框架，使相关方之间能够更好地协作。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0015:c006",
      "pdf_page": 15,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "1.3. Where is the Controls Checklist?",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0015:b033"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        616.194,
        364.608,
        640.98
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G152:s0017"
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0015:c007",
      "pdf_page": 15,
      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "First of all, integrating security is not a matter of selecting controls from a checklist. We advocate a holistic approach towards security, so that a trustworthy, robust, reliable, secure, and risk-managed architecture is delivered. To do this, the Enterprise Security Architecture makes sure that tight cooperation is obtained between the ADM and the processes for ISM and ERM. Therefore, most of the security concepts in this Guide refer to things needed to set up security properly.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0015:b034",
        "G152:p0015:b035",
        "G152:p0015:b036",
        "G152:p0015:b037",
        "G152:p0015:b038"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        650.73,
        563.76,
        728.13
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0016:c000",
      "pdf_page": 16,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "However, designing the operational security is part of the architecture as well. In the architecture context, security controls are bundled into security services. A security service can be seen as an Architecture Building Block (ABB). In the TOGAF Standard, ABBs capture architecture requirements that both direct and guide the development of Solution Building Blocks (SBBs). This can apply to all four of the TOGAF domain architectures: Business, Data, Application, and Technology. text:
2.2 ISO 31000:2009 风险管理——原则与指南
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:2.2",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0020",
  "section_number": "2.2",
  "title_en": "2.2. ISO 31000:2009: Risk Management – Principles and Guidelines",
  "title_zh": "2.2 ISO 31000:2009 风险管理——原则与指南",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",

    17
  ],
  "translation_zh": "ISO 31000:2009 [ISO 31000] 提出适用于公共或私营部门任何类型组织的风险管理原则、框架与过程。它并不强制“一刀切”的做法，而是强调风险管理必须针对特定组织的具体需求与结构进行裁剪。它有一个相关标准 IEC 31010:2009 [IEC 31010]，其中描述了定性风险评估方法示例。\n\n本指南以 ISO 31000:2009 的核心概念作为 ERM 过程的基础。与 ISO/IEC 27001:2013 一样，并未与该标准建立固定映射，而是将其视为对本项工作非常有用的良好参考之一。",

      "text_en": "ISO 31000:2009 [ISO 31000] sets out principles, a framework, and a process for the management of risk that are applicable to any type of organization in the public or private sector. It does not mandate a “one size fits all” approach, but rather emphasizes the fact that the management of risk must be tailored to the specific needs and structure of the particular organization. It has a related standard IEC 31010:2009 [IEC 31010] that describes examples of qualitative risk assessment methods.",

  "translation_zh": "国际上存在许多国家特定的网络安全标准。其中一个领先示例是于 2014 年推出的 NIST 网络安全框架，旨在帮助关键基础设施行业的组织降低风险并保护关键基础设施。该框架把安全功能分为五个领域：识别、保护、检测、响应和恢复。\n\n本指南和后续工作（包括安全服务目录）引入的许多安全与风险概念，对于希望把安全与风险整合到 TOGAF 实践及企业架构中的关键基础设施安全架构师，都将很有用。\n\n> 版本说明：这是源文对 2014 年框架和五类功能的介绍，不将其无标记替换为后来的框架版本或声称它代表当前最新功能集合。",

2.6 O-ISM3

    18
  ],
  "translation_zh": "O-ISM3（Open Information Security Management Maturity Model）标准 [C102] 由 The Open Group 于 2011 年发布，描述了以过程方法构建并运行信息安全管理体系（ISMS）的方式。ISMS 的成功运行，通常是企业架构达成组织所设定安全目标的前提。《安全架构从业者指南》将有一章专门讨论企业架构、TOGAF 标准与 ISMS 之间的关系。O-ISM3 把安全服务定义为战略、战术或运营过程，并提供基于度量的过程持续改进方法。\n\n预计 O-ISM3 标准描述的许多服务或过程，也将由安全服务目录项目引用。\n\n> 规划时态：上文“将有”“预计”按原文保留，不据此断言这些后续交付物现已提供在本语料中。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0018:c004",
      "pdf_page": 18,
      "content_index_zero_based": 4,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "2.6. O-ISM3",
      "source_block_ids": [

      "pdf_page": 18,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The Open Information Security Management Maturity Model (O-ISM3) Standard [C102], published by The Open Group in 2011, describes a process-based approach towards building and operating an Information Security Management System (ISMS). Successful operation of the ISMS is generally a prerequisite for Enterprise Architectures to meet the security objectives established by an organization. A chapter of the Security Architecture Practitioners Guide will be devoted to the relationship between Enterprise Architecture, the TOGAF Standard, and ISMSs. The O-ISM3 standard defines security services as strategic, tactical, or operational processes, and provides a metrics-based approach to continuous improvement of the processes. Many of the services or processes described in the O-ISM3 Standard are expected to be referenced in the Security Services Catalog Project as well.",

2.8 SABSA®

  "title_en": "2.8. SABSA®",

  "status": "source-compared-revised",

    19
  ],
  "translation_zh": "SABSA 是开发风险驱动的企业信息安全与信息保障架构、并交付支撑关键业务举措的安全基础设施解决方案的方法论；它是一种开放标准，由若干框架、模型、方法与过程构成。作为企业安全架构框架，它允许在安全架构内使用现有标准与实践（如 ISO/IEC 27001:2013、COBIT 与 ISO 31000:2009）。SABSA 可供所有方免费使用，采用该标准开发与实施架构及解决方案的最终用户组织无需获得许可。SABSA® 蓝皮书 [SABSA, 2005] 对 SABSA 有详细说明；新的 SABSA 思路也发布在 www.sabsa.org [SABSA]。SABSA 的根本理念是安全架构服务于业务，这与 TOGAF 的概念一致。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0019:c000",
      "pdf_page": 19,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,

      "content_index_zero_based": 1,

It is an open standard, comprising a number of frameworks, models, methods, and processes. As an Enterprise Security Architecture framework, it allows for the usage of existing standards and practices (such as ISO/IEC 27001:2013, COBIT, and ISO 31000:2009) within the Security Architecture. SABSA is free for use by all, with no licensing required for end-user organizations that make use of the standard in developing and implementing architectures and solutions.",

        "G152:p0019:b002",

  "translation_zh": "安全架构是由组织、概念、逻辑与物理组件构成的结构，这些组件以连贯方式交互，以实现并维持受管理的风险状态；它是全企业各风险领域中受保护行为（secure）、安全行为（safe）、韧性行为（resilient）、可靠行为（reliable）以及维护隐私的驱动因素与使能因素。\n\n安全架构组件始终与架构中其他要素存在关系；因此，尽管可把安全架构视为“一种架构”，它绝不能是孤立的架构。\n\n安全架构管理的风险有多种，其中两类重要风险是**业务风险**与**运营风险**。安全架构对风险持平衡观点：负面后果控制在可接受水平，正向机会最大化利用。业务驱动方法至关重要：业务驱动为风险评估提供语境，界定是否需要遵循控制框架，并为安全措施提供论证。\n\n为实现安全在架构中的真正整合，应采用系统工程方法：在主题对象的系统工程开发生命周期中尽早考虑安全与风险；在生命周期每个阶段开展适当的安全与风险活动——从早期高层建议与指导，到最终阶段的详细安全检查。由此可获得可靠、安全、有韧性并尊重隐私的安全运营系统，并促成安全行为。\n\n在运营阶段，应对架构的安全方面进行监控、评估与报告。虽然运营阶段通常在 TOGAF ADM 首次迭代完成后才开始，但**衡量安全的能力**需在 ADM 阶段 G 与 H 中设计并纳入。\n\n“企业”一词置于“安全架构”之前，表明其所处理的抽象层次：“企业”意味着最高层面的业务对齐，而非局部层面。TOGAF 标准把“企业”定义为组织的最高描述层级，通常覆盖所有使命与职能，且往往跨越多个组织（政府机构、整个公司、公司事业部、单个部门，或由共同所有权连接的地理分散组织链）。\n\n企业安全架构追求安全措施与业务目标的业务对齐：通过定义不同架构层组件之间的关系，提供可追溯性与论证。企业安全架构师通常利用 ISM 与 ERM 过程开发交付物并与利益相关者互动。",

"text_en": "The adjective “Enterprise” before “Security Architecture” indicates the abstraction layer that the Security Architecture addresses. The concept of “enterprise” implies business alignment at the highest level, rather than at local levels. 3.1.1 风险的定义
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:3.1.1",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0029",

  "title_en": "3.1.1. Definition of Risk",
  "title_zh": "3.1.1 风险的定义",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",

  "translation_zh": "风险是“不确定性对目标的影响”[ISO 31000]。不确定性的影响是任何偏离预期的结果——包括正向与负向。\n\n理解“风险”是理解 ERM 更广泛概念以及有效企业架构与企业安全架构作用的核心。本指南按 ISO 31000:2009 定义风险：风险是不确定性对实现业务目标的影响。不确定性关乎在信息有限的条件下预测未来结果；信息永远不可能完美，但我们期望更高质量的信息能带来更高质量的决策。每项决策都基于对潜在机会与威胁的平衡评估：有利结果与损害结果的可能性、潜在正负事件的量级，以及每种已识别结果的可能性。识别并评估这些因素称为“风险评估”或“风险分析”；“风险管理”是把这些概念应用于决策过程的艺术与科学。\n\n风险可见于战略长期层（业务总体方向）、中期战术层（转型项目与项目群）与运营层（日常运营决策、流程与实践）。风险管理的目标是优化业务成果，最大化业务价值、最小化业务损失。风险可见于业务栈的任何层级（图 3-1），但始终由业务价值评估及其优化自上而下驱动。\n\n不确定性通常涉及信息不足，导致知识或理解不充分。在风险管理语境中，当对事件、后果或可能性的知识或理解不充分时，就存在不确定性。\n\n这种平衡的风险观也体现在 SABSA 中：既使能机会带来的收益，也控制威胁的影响。可以说，企业架构师的唯一角色就是创造一个运营环境，使运营风险得以优化——业务收益最大、业务损失最小。\n\n运营风险关注业务运营中出现的威胁与机会。SABSA 是架构与运营框架，用于把握机会、使能正向结果以达成既定业务目标，并把损失事件的负向结果控制在企业的风险容忍度（即风险偏好）之内。\n\n图 3-1：业务风险与网络风险领域（© The SABSA Institute）。图 3-2：SABSA 运营风险模型（© The SABSA Institute）。原图、范围与关系读取本节 structured_references。\n\n> 术语边界：本段按源文把企业对风险的容忍与 risk appetite 联系起来；此处不是对所有其他风险框架中 risk appetite 与 risk tolerance 的统一等同定义。“企业架构师的唯一角色”前有 Arguably，是论述观点而非岗位职责的排他规则。",

      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Understanding the term “risk” is central to understanding the broader concepts of ERM, and the role of effective Enterprise Architecture and Enterprise Security Architecture. In this Guide we define risk in line with ISO 31000:2009. Risk is the effect that uncertainty has on the achievement of business objectives. The uncertainty is concerned with predicting future outcomes, given the limited amount of information available when making a business decision. This information can never be perfect, although our expectation is that given better quality information we can make better quality decisions. Every decision is based on assessing the balance between potential opportunities and threats, the likelihood of beneficial outcomes versus damaging outcomes, the magnitude of these potential positive or negative events, and the likelihood associated with each identified outcome. Identifying and assessing these factors is known as “risk assessment” or “risk analysis”. “Risk management” is the art and science of applying these concepts in the decision-making process. Risk can be seen at the strategic long-term level (overall direction of the business), the medium term tactical level (transformation projects and programs), and at the operational level (regular day-to-day operational decisions, processes, and practices). The objective of risk management is to optimize business outcomes to maximize business value and minimize business losses. 3.1.2 ERM 的核心概念

  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",

    23,

  ],
  "translation_zh": "据 ISO 31000:2009，风险管理过程通过考虑不确定性以及未来事件或情形（有意或无意）及其对既定目标的影响来辅助决策。该标准给出风险管理过程模型，并明确风险管理应深植于所有业务活动，是持续的生命周期而非孤立活动。本指南采用该定义。\n\n该定义的核心是：有效的风险管理就是“管理到预期目标”。每一步都有需要管理的风险要素，每个结果都不确定；ERM 就是降低不确定性。\n\n图 3-3：ISO 31000:2009 风险管理模型（源自 ISO 31000）。原图、图元与当前关系解释读取本节 structured_references。\n\nERM 的重要概念包括：\n\n- 关键风险领域（Key Risk Areas）；\n- 业务影响分析（Business Impact Analysis）；\n- 风险评估（Risk Assessment）；\n- 业务风险模型/风险登记册（Business Risk Model / Risk Register）；\n- 风险偏好（Risk Appetite）；\n- 风险缓解计划/风险处置计划（Risk Mitigation / Treatment Plan）。",

It also gives a risk management process model, as illustrated in Figure 3-3. The ISO 31000:2009 approach makes it clear that risk management should be embedded deeply and firmly in all business activities. 3.2.1 安全
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:3.2.1",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0032",
  "section_number": "3.2.1",
  "title_en": "3.2.1. Security",
  "title_zh": "3.2.1 安全",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    25,
    26
  ],
  "translation_zh": "许多安全从业者认为安全基于三大支柱：保密性、完整性与可用性（CIA 三要素）。这在需要对信息系统分类以确定适用安全需求的技术环境中颇为有效；可按密级方案（高-中-低）分类。尤其在金融行业，基于 CIA 的安全分类方案贯穿整个组织。\n\n然而与业务负责人交流时，这些术语往往对他们没有意义：他们清楚哪些人可访问哪些系统，但并不使用这些“安全”术语；而且三个术语过于宽泛——任何安全关注点都可归入三者之一，其宽泛定义也正是弱点：在不同环境中含义可能完全不同。\n\n例如“可用性”可表示：\n\n- 运行时间——业务时段内系统至少 99.9% 可用；\n- 响应性——每笔交易的最短响应时间为 0.01 毫秒（原文为 minimum response time）；\n- 归档——医疗数据保证存储 7 年；\n- 擦除——服务器送废前所有数据不可恢复；\n- 可恢复——灾难导致系统故障后 24 小时内恢复。\n\n该例说明“可用性”可因范围与语境而有各种含义，也说明我们有更具体的术语可指明所需处理的关注类型。既然这些术语如此复杂、每次都要分析才能真正理解，为何还要继续使用？保密性、完整性、可用性被过度加载，被许多人用于不同目的。我们需要更具体的概念。\n\n因此，本指南从狭窄的 CIA 三要素转向既具体又业务友好的丰富术语——SABSA **业务属性模型**（见“需求管理”一节）。业务属性提供了表达业务所有者安全关注点的灵活而强大的方式。\n\n业务属性模型还支持度量有效性。安全措施的有效性应结合其缓解的风险来考量：企业只有理解资产价值，才能决定愿为保护该资产投入多少；例如，资产在应用中的使用及其由此暴露的风险，决定真正的安全需求；组织的风险容忍度也是因素。换言之，问题不应是“它安全吗？”，而应是“它足够安全吗？”——后者最终由风险评价回答。\n\n为更接地气地说明安全涵盖什么，以下是安全架构师普遍接受的关注领域：\n\n- **资产保护**：保护信息资产免于丢失或非预期披露，保护资源免于未授权与非预期使用；\n- **风险评估**：确定面临的风险，度量其可能性与影响，并按组织风险偏好接受、缓解或转移风险；\n- **访问控制**：你是谁，在什么条件下允许做什么活动？\n- **审计**：运营环境是否按要求运行？\n- **可用性**：在异常或恶意事件下仍能不间断运行、不耗尽的能力。\n\n> 源文与示例说明：minimum response time 为原文措辞，不能擅自改成通常性能约束所写的“最长响应时间”。99.9%、0.01 毫秒、7 年和 24 小时均用于说明可用性语境，不是适用于所有企业的强制参数；在实际采用前需另行明确指标方向和业务依据。",

text:
3.2.2 隐私
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:3.2.2",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0033",
  "section_number": "3.2.2",
  "title_en": "3.2.2. Privacy",
  "title_zh": "3.2.2 隐私",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    26
  ],
  "translation_zh": "隐私是个人或群体使自身或关于自身的信息保持不被外界接触的能力。隐私的边界与内容因文化与个人而异，但有共同主题；隐私领域与安全部分重叠，例如包括恰当使用与信息保护等概念。\n\n一般而言，隐私指令要求除非满足特定条件，否则不得处理个人数据；这些条件分为三类：透明性、合法目的与相称性。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0026:c006",
      "pdf_page": 26,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "3.2.2. Privacy",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0026:b012"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        261.249,
        130.244,
        279.15
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G152:s0033"
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0026:c007",
      "pdf_page": 26,
      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Privacy is the ability of an individual or group to seclude themselves, or information about themselves. The boundaries and content of what is considered private differ among cultures and individuals, but share common themes. The domain of privacy partially overlaps security, including, for instance, the concepts of appropriate use, as well as protection of information.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0026:b013",
        "G152:p0026:b014",
        "G152:p0026:b015",
        "G152:p0026:b016"
      ],

        351.02
      ],

    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0026:c008",
      "pdf_page": 26,
      "content_index_zero_based": 8,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "In general, directives on privacy demand that personal data should not be processed at all, except when certain conditions are met. These conditions fall into three categories: transparency, legitimate purpose, and proportionality.",

        "G152:p0026:b017",
        "G152:p0026:b018",
        "G152:p0026:b019"
      ],
      "bbox": [

      "source_section_id": null
    }
  ],

text:
3.2.3 ISM 的核心概念
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:3.2.3",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0034",
  "section_number": "3.2.3",
  "title_en": "3.2.3. Core Concepts for Information Security Management",
  "title_zh": "3.2.3 ISM 的核心概念",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    26,
    27
  ],
  "translation_zh": "据 ISO/IEC 27001:2013，ISM 体系通过应用风险管理过程保护信息的安全方面，并使相关方确信风险得到充分管理。ISM 体系是组织过程与总体管理结构的一部分并与之整合；该标准规定了 ISM 体系的要求。\n\n与 ISM 过程相关的核心安全概念如下。后文会给出其描述及与 TOGAF ADM 的关系。此处列出这些概念，是为了枚举应成为 TOGAF 标准一部分的核心信息安全概念；采用 ISO/IEC 27001:2013 的主要类别，帮助理解这些概念之间的联系。\n\n**组织语境**\n\n- 安全域模型；\n- 业务驱动/业务目标；\n- 适用法律法规登记册；\n- 适用控制框架登记册；\n- 信任框架。\n\n**领导**\n\n- 安全政策架构。\n\n**策划**\n\n- 安全原则；\n- 业务属性画像；\n- 控制目标/安全目标；\n- 数据质量；\n- 业务风险模型/风险登记册；\n- 安全服务目录。\n\n**支持**\n\n- 安全资源计划；\n- 安全培训与意识；\n- 安全标准。\n\n**运行**\n\n- 安全分类。\n\n**绩效评价**\n\n- 安全审计。\n\n**改进**\n\n- （无新增安全概念）。",

    28
  ],
  "translation_zh": "安全架构是横切关注点（见图 4-1），贯穿整个企业架构。它可以描述为视图、视点和制品的连贯集合，包括安全、隐私和运营风险方面，以及安全目标、安全服务等相关主题。安全架构不只是数据集，而是以 ISM 和 ERM 过程为基础。\n\nTOGAF ADM 涵盖普遍认可为企业架构子集的四个架构域：业务、数据、应用和技术。安全架构与四者都发生交互，因此称为横切关注点。\n\n图 4-1：安全作为贯穿架构的横切关注点。原图和当前结构解析读取本节 structured_references。\n\n作为横切关注点，安全架构影响业务、数据、应用和技术架构，并为其提供输入。安全架构往往可能由架构范围之外的组织负责，但其中一些部分仍需与架构一体化开发。第 5 章将解释这些接触点。",

  "translation_zh": "TOGAF ADM 包含“制品”（工作产品）概念，各阶段消费或产出制品。为与之匹配，企业安全架构的核心概念以 TOGAF 术语表达并与 TOGAF 概念关联，确保相关风险与安全概念在适当 ADM 阶段被正确嵌入。\n\n全部选定的 SABSA 制品概览见图 1-1。以下各节按 TOGAF ADM 阶段进一步解释这些核心安全概念；除描述外，还注明其在“架构框架”中的位置：若已在 TOGAF 标准中则给出该位置，否则给出企业安全架构位置。这里的企业安全架构是涵盖 ISM 和 ERM 的通用安全架构概念。",

{

  "title_en": "5.1.3. Risk Appetite",

  "translation_zh": "架构框架中的位置：企业安全架构：ERM。\n\n描述企业对风险的态度，为组织平衡“为实现预期结果所承担的风险量”提供决策指导。可表达为风险/业务影响与可能性网格上的边界、损益度量或定性度量（对生命损失或合规违规零容忍）；也可由措辞恰当的安全原则表示，或在存在需专门批准的关键利益相关者时作为独立交付物。它既定义组织愿意接受的风险水平，也定义确定该水平的策略；对高于可接受水平的风险，定义缓解策略（转移、规避）。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0030:c001",
      "pdf_page": 30,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "5.1.3. Risk Appetite",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0030:b003"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        83.229,
        167.45,
        101.13
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G152:s0041"
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0030:c002",
      "pdf_page": 30,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Location in the Architecture Framework: Enterprise Security Architecture: ERM.",
      "source_block_ids": [

        125.66
      ],

    {
      "id": "G152:p0030:c003",
      "pdf_page": 30,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Risk appetite describes the enterprise’s attitude towards risk and provides decision-making guidance to the organization to balance the amount of risk taken to achieve an expected outcome. The risk appetite could be expressed as, for example, a boundary on a risk/business impact and likelihood grid, profit, and loss measures or qualitative measures (zero tolerance for loss of life or regulatory compliance breaches). Risk appetite can also be represented by suitably worded Security Principles, or produced as a stand-alone deliverable if a key stakeholder exists who needs to approve it specifically. It defines both the level of risk the organization is willing to accept as well as its strategy in defining this level. For risks above this acceptable level, it defines the strategy used for mitigation (transference, avoidance).",

  "status": "source-compared-revised",

  "translation_zh": "架构框架中的位置：TOGAF 标准《架构开发方法》的预备阶段和阶段 A。\n\n在定义并建立企业架构团队的预备阶段，处理整个架构团队的资源规划；在阶段 A，根据具体架构项目评估架构团队能力时，也处理该规划。根据团队职责与项目范围，识别交付架构安全要素所需的安全资源。定义企业架构团队的关键部分，是确立安全架构师的预期角色与授权；最佳实践安全架构把安全与风险整合进所有领域，其核心是在企业架构治理过程语境中建立安全架构治理过程。\n\n以下问题有助于识别团队与架构项目所需的安全与风险资源：\n\n- 常见的安全或风险相关关注点是什么？\n- 是否存在需要特定安全视图的关键且有影响力的安全/风险利益相关者？\n- 架构是否涉及高风险领域，或风险偏好较低？\n- 可从现有安全团队按需请求安全支持，还是需要专职安全架构资源作为总体架构团队的一部分？\n\n预备阶段应决定企业架构中真正需要哪些安全制品、由谁创建。为恰当处理安全，未必需要交付全部安全制品；反之，交付全部制品也不保证安全得到妥善处理——可能需要更多制品。\n\n对企业级架构，制品需基于与关键利益相关者的讨论、架构团队的初步评估，以及对相关法规、适用司法辖区、立法与监管的评估来创建。对能力级架构，可能存在现有来源，例如企业级安全策略或风险评估已描述特定语境的安全原则、风险偏好与关键风险领域。",

text:
5.2 阶段 A：架构愿景
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:5.2",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0044",
  "section_number": "5.2",
  "title_en": "5.2. Phase A: Architecture Vision",

  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",

    31,
    32

  "translation_zh": "阶段 A 通常描述足够的 B、C、D 阶段内容，确保关键利益相关者能就终态愿景达成一致，该愿景表示对一个已定义问题的解决方案。阶段 A 中开展足够的安全特定架构设计，以：\n\n- 使安全利益相关者确信终态不包含未知或不可接受的风险，并符合公司政策、标准与原则；\n- 使业务利益相关者（尤其预算控制者）确信安全架构有助于使能并支撑总体架构，在风险、合规与业务收益之间取得恰当平衡，从而交付所识别的业务机会与收益。\n\n阶段 A 必须识别全部利益相关者清单、其关注点及批准架构所需的相关需求。所有利益相关者都有安全与风险关注点及相关需求；把安全利益相关者割裂出去，会使架构仅处理利益相关者的一个子集及需求的一个子集。\n\n收集利益相关者需求以确定应对各种关注点所需的安全蓝图；安全蓝图定义到足以使利益相关者确信最终制品与交付物将恰当处理其关注点的程度；相关 ADM 阶段完成蓝图并补充所需细节。\n\n利益相关者通常有与安全架构相关的价值关注点；价值可度量诸如降低风险、使能总体架构等事项。**业务属性画像**可作为商业论证的基础；若尚无特定业务属性画像，可使用 SABSA 提供的画像作为起点。可采用基于场景的方法获得利益相关者批准。视点与商业论证必须建立在安全原则、驱动因素、关键风险与风险偏好之上，并应成为总体架构愿景交付物的组成部分。",

5.3.7 适用控制框架登记册

    34

  "translation_zh": "架构框架中的位置：企业安全架构：ISM。\n\n该登记册包含一组适合的控制框架，它们最能满足与工作范围及语境相关的要求，并应对相关风险。控制框架包含要求和/或强制性安全措施。控制框架的示例有 ISO/IEC 27001:2013、ISO/IEC 27002:2013、COBIT、PCI-DSS、Common Criteria 等。驱动控制框架选择的因素包括：\n\n  - 由于业务流程或行业的性质而必须获得的认证；\n  - 内部 ISM 过程的工作方式——这通常受 ISO/IEC 27001:2013 启发，但也可能强制要求采用额外的控制框架；\n  - 营销目标——客户可能要求特定的控制框架认证；\n  - 对安全审计的支持。",

text:
5.4.3 数据质量
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:5.4.3",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0056",
  "section_number": "5.4.3",
  "title_en": "5.4.3. Data Quality",
  "title_zh": "5.4.3 数据质量",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    36
  ],
  "translation_zh": "从企业安全架构视角，数据质量是安全需求的组成部分，相关风险评估与措施选择亦然。数据质量是运营风险管理的关键因素；关键属性包括准确性、相关性、及时性、时效性、完整性、一致性、可用性与可访问性。保障数据质量始于清晰的数据集概览；应为每个数据集分配质量所有权与责任，所有者授权可信人员/流程在特定条件下对数据执行特定活动；必要时需修改信息系统以正确处理数据；最后应基于日志与性能数据度量各关键属性。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0036:c004",
      "pdf_page": 36,

      "pdf_page": 36,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Note: From an Enterprise Security Architecture perspective, data quality[3] requirements are an integral part of the security requirements and so are the related risk assessment and selection of measures.",

      "pdf_page": 36,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Data quality is a key factor in operational risk management. Some of the key attributes that contribute to data quality are accuracy, relevance, timeliness, currency, completeness, consistency, availability, and accessibility. Safeguarding data quality starts with a clear overview on the datasets in question. For each dataset, ownership and responsibility for the quality of data needs to be assigned. The owner authorizes people or processes that are trusted for a certain activity on the data under certain circumstances. It might also be necessary to change information systems in order to handle the data properly. Finally, each of the key attributes should be measured based on log and performance data.",

    36

  "translation_zh": "多数情况下，无需开发特定的技术架构安全制品，只要技术架构纳入前序阶段定义的安全控制与机制即可。安全架构师必须确保所需控制被纳入技术架构，并验证其使用是否有效、高效；这包括提供与调节系统资源（电力、处理能力、网络带宽、内存等）的技术。安全利益相关者可要求创建特定的技术架构安全视图或交付物，描述所有安全相关技术组件及其相互关系；该视图应说明哪些技术缓解了哪些业务风险，为技术选择提供论证。",

section_title: 5.6 阶段 E：机会与解决方案
text:
5.6 阶段 E：机会与解决方案
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:5.6",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0058",
  "section_number": "5.6",
  "title_en": "5.6. Phase E: Opportunities and Solutions",
  "title_zh": "5.6 阶段 E：机会与解决方案",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    37
  ],
  "translation_zh": "在定义路线图（确定差距处理顺序）时，必须评估安全与风险；确保分析中回应利益相关者的安全与风险关注，咨询风险所有者。工作包预期交付的价值应包含安全与风险价值度量，确保路线图覆盖完整的业务目标与驱动因素。\n\n前序阶段定义的安全构建块在此阶段成为 **SBB**，需定义更具体的实施导向要求与规格；此阶段可能需要完整的解决方案设计。基线安全架构的安全服务目录很可能包含满足要求的现有安全服务或构建块（例如已有集中认证服务可满足应用访问控制需求）。必须验证拟复用的现有安全服务与控制的有效性，确保最终状态包含有效且良好集成的安全措施。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0037:c000",
      "pdf_page": 37,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "5.6. Phase E: Opportunities and Solutions",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0037:b001"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        34.434,
        406.692,
        59.22
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G152:s0058"
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0037:c001",
      "pdf_page": 37,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "In defining the roadmap, where the sequence of gaps to be addressed is determined, it is imperative that security and risk are evaluated. Ensure the stakeholders’ security and risk concerns are addressed in the analysis. Confirm that risk owners are consulted. The value expected to be delivered by work packages should include measures related to security and risk value to ensure the roadmap addresses the complete set of business goals and drivers.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0037:b002",
        "G152:p0037:b003",
        "G152:p0037:b004",
        "G152:p0037:b005",
        "G152:p0037:b006"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        68.97,
        563.76,
        146.37
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0037:c002",
      "pdf_page": 37,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The security building blocks defined in the previous phases become SBBs in this phase so that more specific implementation-oriented requirements and specifications are defined. A whole solution design might be needed at this stage.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0037:b007",
        "G152:p0037:b008",
        "G152:p0037:b009"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        159.87,
        563.76,
        205.71
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0037:c003",
      "pdf_page": 37,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The Security Services Catalog of the Baseline Security Architecture probably contains existing security services or security building blocks that meet the requirements. For example, if the requirement exists for application access control, an existing central authentication service might be used to fill that in. The efficacy of existing security services and controls earmarked for re-use must be verified to ensure that the end-state contains security measures, which work and integrate well.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0037:b010",
        "G152:p0037:b011",
        "G152:p0037:b012",
        "G152:p0037:b013",
        "G152:p0037:b014"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        219.21,
        563.76,
        296.61
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    }
  ],
  "semantic_rules": [
    {
      "id": "G152:5.6:rule01",
      "kind": "roadmap-risk",
      "statement_zh": "路线图和工作包价值评估应包含安全风险，咨询风险所有者。",
      "boundary_zh": "不能只按成本进度排序而忽略风险。",
      "evidence": [
        {
          "source_unit_id": "G152:p0037:c001",
          "pdf_page": 37,
          "source_block_ids": [

    37

  "translation_zh": "迁移本身是需要保障的业务流程。迁移策略应包括风险评估与风险缓解计划；在阶段 F，风险缓解计划限于**过渡**范围。迁移生产环境（live environments）时应始终包含**回退规划**，以便在迁移失败时回退——这是风险管理的重要组成部分。此外，迁移规划应包括**安全影响分析**，理解目标状态变更的安全影响。",

section_title: 5.9 阶段 H：架构变更管理
text:
5.9 阶段 H：架构变更管理
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:5.9",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0064",
  "section_number": "5.9",
  "title_en": "5.9. Phase H: Architecture Change Management",
  "title_zh": "5.9 阶段 H：架构变更管理",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    38,
    39
  ],
  "translation_zh": "阶段 H 不产出有形安全交付物，但定义两个对业务需求与架构持续对齐至关重要的过程：**风险管理**与**架构治理**。虽非正式制品，但在此强调其重要性。\n\nERM 过程持续评估现有架构面对业务机会与安全威胁变化的情况；若现有架构不适合缓解变化或新增风险，或过度约束业务利用新机会，则必须做出架构变更决策。架构治理过程决定对现有架构的变更——在当前迭代中做小改动，或启动全新迭代；TOGAF 标准《EA 能力与治理》的架构治理框架部分对此有说明。风险与安全相关变更应成为该框架的明确部分；重大架构变更应包括安全影响分析。\n\n变更由新需求或环境变化驱动：威胁环境变化、合规要求变化、发现现有流程与解决方案漏洞，都可能引发安全需求变化。安全原因导致的变更往往比简化或增量变更更具破坏性。决定安全变更是否触发新的 ADM 迭代时须审慎——例如企业风险偏好变化时，看似很小的安全需求变更也可能触发新的架构开发周期。可在现有架构内应用的变更示例是安全标准或要求变化：这类变更通常破坏性较小，因为采纳的权衡基于变更价值（风险评估）——在业务改进机会、业务感知的安全威胁与变更本身带来的威胁之间权衡；这正是 SABSA 风险平衡概念可用于决策的典型场景。因此，负责架构变更管理的架构变更委员会或其他治理结构必须包含具备安全技能的人员。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0038:c009",
      "pdf_page": 38,
      "content_index_zero_based": 9,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "5.9. Phase H: Architecture Change Management",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0038:b020"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        458.074,
        456.984,
        482.86
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G152:s0064"
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0038:c010",
      "pdf_page": 38,
      "content_index_zero_based": 10,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Phase H does not produce tangible security outputs but defines two processes essential for continued alignment between the business requirements and the architecture: risk management and architecture governance. Even though they are not formal artifacts, they are added here to emphasize their importance.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0038:b021",
        "G152:p0038:b022",
        "G152:p0038:b023",
        "G152:p0038:b024"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        492.61,
        563.76,
        554.23
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0038:c011",
      "pdf_page": 38,
      "content_index_zero_based": 11,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "ERM is the process in which the existing architecture is continuously evaluated regarding changes to business opportunity and security threat. Based on the results of this process, the current architecture might deem it unsuitable to mitigate changed or new risks, or it might constrain the business too much in exploiting new opportunities. In that case, a decision on architecture change must be made.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0038:b025",
        "G152:p0038:b026",
        "G152:p0038:b027",
        "G152:p0038:b028"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        567.73,
        563.76,
        629.35
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0038:c012",
      "pdf_page": 38,
      "content_index_zero_based": 12,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Architecture governance is the process in which decisions are made on changes to the existing architecture, either by minor changes in the current iteration or by means of a completely new iteration. This is explained in the TOGAF Standard — EA Capability and Governance (Architecture Governance Framework). Changes related to risk and security should be an explicit part of that framework. Large changes to the architecture should include a security impact analysis.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0038:b029",
        "G152:p0038:b030",
        "G152:p0038:b031",
        "G152:p0038:b032",
        "G152:p0038:b033"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        642.85,
        563.76,
        720.25
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0039:c000",
      "pdf_page": 39,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Change is driven by new requirements or changes in the environment. For instance, changes in security requirements can be caused by changes in the threat environment, changed compliance requirements, or changes due to discovered vulnerabilities in the existing processes and solutions. Changes required due to security-related causes are often more disruptive than a simplification or incremental change.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0039:b001",
        "G152:p0039:b002",
        "G152:p0039:b003",
        "G152:p0039:b004",
        "G152:p0039:b005"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        36.75,
        563.76,
        114.15
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0039:c001",
      "pdf_page": 39,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Due care must be taken in deciding whether a security change triggers a new iteration though the TOGAF ADM cycle – for instance, when enterprise risk appetite changes – a seemingly small security requirement change can easily trigger a new architecture development cycle.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G152:p0039:b006",
        "G152:p0039:b007",
        "G152:p0039:b008"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        127.65,
        563.76,
        173.49
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G152:p0039:c002",
      "pdf_page": 39,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "An example of where changes can be applied within the existing architecture is when security standards or requirements change. This is usually less disruptive since the trade-off for their adoption is based on the value of the change – that is, evaluation of the risk – the trade-off between the opportunity for business improvement, the perceived threat to the business in security terms, and the threat posed by the change itself, which would perhaps be very disruptive and expensive. This is an excellent example of where the SABSA concept of balancing risks can be applied to decision-making.",

text:
5.10 需求管理
{
  "id": "G152:chapter-review:5.10",
  "source_section_id": "G152:s0065",
  "section_number": "5.10",
  "title_en": "5.10. Requirements Management",
  "title_zh": "5.10 需求管理",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "source-expanded-existing-summary",
  "pdf_pages": [
    39
  ],
  "translation_zh": "需求管理在架构工作中居于核心地位，TOGAF 标准对此予以认可。需求管理通过受控、可重复的过程，在架构开发的不同阶段识别、存储、维护并沟通业务需求。此外，还要对照目标需求监控运营绩效。这在 TOGAF ADM 中没有被明确处理，但属于阶段 H：架构变更管理及需求管理的持续验证范围。\n\nTOGAF 方法在架构开发项目的每个阶段验证并更新业务需求，但 TOGAF 标准未规定描述或记录需求必须采用的技术。SABSA 提供这种技术——其独特的业务属性画像构建（Business Attribute Profiling）技术，可有效描述需求。本节说明该技术在安全需求管理中的使用，以及它对一般需求管理的收益。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G152:p0039:c004",
      "pdf_page": 39,
      "content_index_zero_based": 4,
      "type": "heading",

5.10.1 业务属性画像

  "translation_zh": "架构框架中的位置：企业安全架构：ISM。\n\n业务属性画像构建是一种 SABSA 需求工程技术，采用基于风险的方法把业务目标与驱动因素转化为需求。它的重要优势包括：\n\n- 用非 IT 术语与高管沟通。\n- 建立业务驱动因素与需求之间的可追溯映射。\n- 对照业务定义的目标度量绩效。\n- 对需求分组与结构化，便于架构师理解和监督。\n\nSABSA 业务属性画像是 SABSA 方法论的核心。这种需求工程技术使 SABSA 独具特色，并连接业务需求与技术/过程设计。参见 SABSA® 蓝皮书 [SABSA, 2005]。\n\n图 5-1：SABSA 业务属性分类法示例（© The SABSA Institute）。图内属性与当前解析读取本节 structured_references。\n\n图 5-1 示例分类法中的每个 SABSA 业务属性，都有详细通用定义以及对该属性应用度量的一些建议；这些细节没有包含在本概览中。架构师以分类法为指南建立业务属性画像，目标是记录当前业务论证相关的属性，按该业务论证重新定义每个选中属性，并制定与其相关的测量方法、具体指标与绩效目标。模型灵活且可适应；必要时，应增加新属性和新定义以满足业务需要。因此，方法虽然有明确规定，业务属性分类法仍可适当扩展，每个画像都需要按架构团队考虑的业务论证高度定制。\n\n选择度量并设定目标是画像的组成部分，使运营阶段可以测量绩效——“是否命中目标？”业务分析师既可使用详细示例建议的指标，也可在更合适时创建新指标。最终，可能建立实时运营风险仪表板，对照预先确定的绩效目标监控运营能力，并对可能需要管理干预的未来风险事件发出预警。\n\nO-ISM3 把绩效目标称为“安全目标值”（security targets）。除了按业务关切表达安全目标，O-ISM3 还定义可容忍偏差。所有 O-ISM3 目标（业务与安全）都必须包含相应的安全目标值，即管理层在采取纠正措施之前能容忍的、相对于预期成果的最大偏差。O-ISM3 可支持任何指定偏差，从而支持和管理理想型目标（允许偏差可能很大）及关键目标（通常合规范围很窄）。\n\n安全目标值通常以发生频率和成本阈值定义。未达到目标时可接受的业务影响，反映了与其他优先事项和目标之间的权衡。安全目标值表明组织对信息安全投资的期望；在某种意义上，管理层定义目标值的行为也界定了其风险偏好。",

"text_en": "Each SABSA Business Attribute in the example taxonomy of Figure 5-1 has a detailed generic definition and some suggested guidelines for applying metrics to that attribute, not included in this overview. A Business Attribute Profile is built by the architects, using the taxonomy as a guideline. The objective is to document the relevant attributes for the business case in hand, redefining each selected attribute in terms of the business case, developing a measurement approach, specific metrics, and performance targets, again related to the business case. The model is flexible and adaptive. When needed, new attributes and new definitions should be added to fulfill the business requirements. Thus, although the method is well defined, the Business Attribute taxonomy can be extended as much as is appropriate and each Business Attribute Profile is highly customized according to the business case being considered by the architecture team.",

      "text_en": "In O-ISM3, performance targets are called “security targets”.   "status": "source-compared-revised",

    42
  ],
  "translation_zh": "架构框架中的位置：企业安全架构：ISM。\n\n控制目标（有时称为安全目标）是给定流程、人员、活动、系统或数据集所期望达到的安全状态。它与安全需求不同：目标是 ISM 过程力求实现的目的，因此控制目标可能并不与安全需求完全一致。控制目标与业务属性相关联。\n\nO-ISM3 通过**依赖分析**记录信息安全对达成业务目标的贡献。依赖分析的输出是一组安全目标，这些目标构成 ISMS 设计、实施与监控的基础；在规划企业架构时，它们也构成安全组件的业务目标。\n\n安全目标由业务目标导出，明确陈述信息安全如何为业务目标做出贡献。\n\n由业务目标“为所提供的全部产品与服务开具发票”导出的安全目标示例如下：\n\n- 发票仅会计团队与催收团队可以访问；\n- 已付款的发票保存三年，并在不超过四年后销毁。\n\n> 示例边界：发票仅会计与催收团队可访问、保留三年至最迟四年销毁，是原文说明依赖分析的示例；不构成适用于所有司法辖区或当前项目的保存期限要求。",

  "translation_zh": "架构框架中的位置：TOGAF 标准《架构内容》的标准库提供存储区，保存架构必须符合的规范集。标准可适用于 TOGAF 的每个架构域；安全标准也可加入此现有目录。\n\n安全架构指导在何种情况下使用哪些安全标准；某安全标准是否适用由业务所有者或业务分析师决定，若适用，则通过需求管理过程将其应用于架构工作。该标准可规定业务、数据、应用或技术架构的安全控制。标准用于确保众多不同组件能够集成为更大的系统；标准类型包括法规标准、技术标准等，例如适用于支付卡行业的 PCI-DSS 标准、适用于电信行业的 ETSI 标准。还需注意，安全标准既可能由外部强制施加，也可能是内部制定的。",

  "translation_zh": "TOGAF® 系列指南说明如何使用 TOGAF 标准，以及如何裁剪以满足具体需要。\n\n系列指南预期是 TOGAF 标准中发展最快的部分，定位为标准的指导部分。TOGAF 基础内容预期保持长期稳定，而使用指导可针对行业、架构风格、用途与问题。例如，扩展企业转型所需的利益相关者、关注点、视图与支撑模型，可能与内部 IT 环境迁移到云所需内容显著不同；两者都使用 ADM，都从架构愿景开始，开发目标架构，并走向实施与迁移计划。TOGAF 基础内容是跨行业、领域和风格的必要支架。",

  "translation_zh": "企业架构成功的一个关键因素，是它与业务需求的关联程度，以及它能否可证明地支持并使能企业实现业务目标。任何架构工作都必须从“解决方案需要满足的需求”的基线视图开始。试想在不了解“为何需要仓库”的情况下指导建造仓库：可能建成一座适合存放大型机械部件的优秀仓库，但实际需求是存放家庭用品。在不理解“为什么”的情况下创建架构，通常会导致解决方案与需求错配。\n\n**业务场景方法**是一种通过理解并记录业务场景关键要素、在连续迭代中验证、细化或改变架构工作前提的技术。其中：\n\n- 每次迭代都需要规划、数据收集、分析、文档化与评审；\n- 每次迭代应改进一个或多个关键要素；\n- 迭代重复进行，直到理解程度足以支持“继续推进”的决策。\n\n不审视业务场景的全部要素，存在产出不完整解决方案的风险；但也必须注意避免不必要的反复。\n\n业务场景方法可用于企业架构开发的多个阶段——主要是预备阶段、架构愿景与业务架构阶段，必要时也可用于其他架构阶段——以直接从业务高层需求推导架构特征。该技术用于帮助识别、理解并记录业务需求，从而导出架构开发必须处理的业务需求，并以**业务场景**文档记录。\n\n业务场景是对以下内容的统一描述：\n\n- 真实业务问题；\n- 问题发生的业务与技术环境；\n- 由业务能力 [G211] 使能的价值流 [G178]；\n- 正确执行后的期望成果；\n- 提供这些能力的人与计算组件（“参与者”）。\n\n\n良好的业务场景还应是“SMART”的：\n\n- **具体**（Specific）：明确业务中需要做什么；\n- **可度量**（Measurable）：通过清晰的成功度量指标；\n- **可行动**（Actionable）：清晰切分问题，并为确定解决方案要素与计划提供基础；\n- **现实**（Realistic）：问题可在物理现实、时间与成本约束内解决；\n- **有时限**（Time-bound）：明确说明解决方案机会何时失效。\n\n第 9 章给出应考虑成果的详细示例。无论采用何种成果，关键都是使其 SMART。\n\n关于业务场景与业务场景方法的进一步说明：\n\n- **业务场景不只关乎 IT**，尽管其起源如此。业务场景同样关乎理解业务价值、价值流与业务成果，以及改进价值流、达成成果、交付业务价值通常需要哪些资源。\n- **业务场景不限于 IT 行业**，该技术可应用于医疗、交通、油气、彩票等任何行业的需求理解。\n- **业务场景不只适用于大问题领域**，既可应用于国家彩票标准等非常广泛的问题，也可应用于零售 POS 升级等非常聚焦的小问题。\n- **业务场景与架构一样不是终点**——终点是达成期望的业务成果。因此，必须有下游路径用业务场景驱动架构工作，并忠实驱动解决方案实施。\n- **业务场景是特定时点的陈述**，应随重大变化更新。\n\n业务场景**不是**：\n\n- 用例（如 OMG、Rational 软件中的用例）——用例是更详细的人与计算机交互描述，通常用于软件开发项目；\n- 业务模型、商业论证或业务场景计划——但业务场景可由公司业务模型启发，SMART 业务场景也可为商业论证/业务模型/计划提供输入；\n- SPIN（情境、问题、暗示、需求满足的销售策略）——SPIN 是可用于为业务场景收集信息的销售技术，业务场景可为 SPIN 提供相关语境；\n- 任何典型工程规格（如 IEEE 规格）的替代品——后者更详细、更面向材料，并更贴近科学。",

text:
2. 业务场景的收益
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:2",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0014",
  "section_number": "2",
  "title_en": "2. Benefits of Business Scenarios",
  "title_zh": "2. 业务场景的收益",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    16,
    17
  ],
  "translation_zh": "业务场景本质上是对业务问题的完整描述——既从业务角度、也从架构角度——使各项需求能够在整体问题的语境中相互关联地审视。缺少这样的完整描述作为语境：\n\n- 架构有基于不完整需求集的风险，这些需求不能构成完整的问题描述，从而误导架构工作；\n- 解决问题的业务价值不清晰；\n- 潜在解决方案的相关性不清晰。\n\n此外，由于该技术要求业务线管理者与其他利益相关者在架构项目早期参与，它在赢得这些关键人员对项目及最终产物（企业架构）的认同方面也发挥重要作用。\n\n业务场景的另一个优势是**与供应商沟通**。当今多数架构通过最大限度利用商用现成品（COTS）软件实现，这些软件常来自多个供应商并在公开市场采购。客户使用业务场景可帮助供应商交付恰当解决方案：供应商需确保其解决方案组件为开放解决方案增值并具有市场性；业务场景提供了供应商社区把客户问题与解决方案联系起来的语言。它不仅说明需要什么、为什么需要，还使供应商能够利用开放标准、借助彼此技能来最优地解决问题。\n\n创建业务场景需要时间与精力；若做得对，这项投资会有回报，回报汇总如下。若不开展，或做得不对，解决方案开发人员与实际业务之间将持续存在更多同类问题：\n\n- **更好的解决方案**：通过理解真实需求及解决这些需求对业务的价值，可带来与业务清晰对齐、并实现新能力的解决方案。与业务领导者会面并把更好的解决方案摆上桌面，可形成可重复的关系，带来引入新能力的良性循环。\n- **更快实现能力**：通过理解真实需求及相关时间要求，解决方案可按时间序列交付，而非一次性“大爆炸”式交付，从而更快实现与业务需求对齐的增量价值，这也与敏捷和 DevOps 方法一致。\n- **更低成本**：通过理解真实业务需求并增量处理，最终节省成本——既节约成本，也避免成本。节约成本的例子包括只实现所需内容、消除冗余；避免成本的例子包括消除失败实施的代价、降低集成与互操作成本。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G176:p0016:c000",
      "pdf_page": 16,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "2. Benefits of Business Scenarios",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0016:b001"
      ],
      "bbox": [

      "id": "G176:p0016:c001",
      "pdf_page": 16,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "A Business Scenario is essentially a complete description of a business problem, both in business and in architectural terms, which enables individual requirements to be viewed in relation to one another in the context of the overall problem. Without such a complete description to serve as context:",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0016:b002",
        "G176:p0016:b003",
        "G176:p0016:b004"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,

    {
      "id": "G176:p0016:c002",
      "pdf_page": 16,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• There is a danger of the architecture being based on an incomplete set of requirements that do not add up to a whole problem description, and that can therefore misguide architecture work",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0016:b005",
        "G176:p0016:b006"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,

    {
      "id": "G176:p0016:c003",
      "pdf_page": 16,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• The business value of solving the problem is unclear",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0016:b007"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        170.63,
        328.11,
        184.91
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0016:c004",
      "pdf_page": 16,
      "content_index_zero_based": 4,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• The relevance of potential solutions is unclear",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0016:b008"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        192.41,
        296.663,
        206.69
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0016:c005",
      "pdf_page": 16,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Also, because the technique requires the involvement of business line management and other stakeholders at an early stage in the architecture project, it also plays an important role in gaining the buy-in of these key personnel to the overall project and its end-product – the Enterprise Architecture.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0016:b009",
        "G176:p0016:b010",
        "G176:p0016:b011"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        220.19,
        563.76,
        266.03
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0016:c006",
      "pdf_page": 16,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "An additional advantage of Business Scenarios is in communication with vendors. Most architecture today is implemented by making maximum use of Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) software solutions, often from multiple vendors, procured in the open market. The use of Business Scenarios by a customer can be an important aid to vendors in delivering appropriate solutions. Vendors need to ensure that their solution components add value to an open solution and are marketable. Business Scenarios provide a language with which the vendor community can link customer problems and solutions. Besides making obvious what is needed, and why, they allow vendors to solve problems optimally, using open standards and leveraging each other’s skills.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0016:b012",
        "G176:p0016:b013",
        "G176:p0016:b014",
        "G176:p0016:b015",
        "G176:p0016:b016",
        "G176:p0016:b017",
        "G176:p0016:b018",
        "G176:p0016:b019"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        279.53,
        563.76,
        404.27
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0016:c007",
      "pdf_page": 16,
      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Creating a Business Scenario takes time and effort and if done right there is a return on this investment summarized in the following list. If not done, or done wrong, more of the same issues will exist between solutions developers and the actual business.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0016:b020",
        "G176:p0016:b021",
        "G176:p0016:b022"
      ],

  "translation_zh": "创建业务场景包括完成六个步骤，覆盖图 3-1 的五个要素：\n\n1. 识别、记录并排序驱动该场景的问题；\n2. 识别场景的业务与技术环境，并在场景模型（含价值流与业务能力）中记录；\n3. 识别并记录期望成果（成功处理问题的结果），使其 SMART；\n4. 识别人的参与者及其在业务模型中的位置；\n5. 识别计算机参与者（计算元素）及其在技术模型中的位置；\n6. 检验“适用性”，仅在必要时细化。\n\n图 3-1：创建业务场景。原图、图元及当前关系解释读取本节 structured_references。\n\n关键术语说明：\n\n- **成果**：项目或组织所提供之物带来的变化、收益、学习或其他效果。\n- **能力**：组织、人或系统拥有的本领。开发业务场景时，指在已知环境中通过价值流中的人力/物力资源达成成果的能力。\n- **业务能力**：企业为达成特定目的或成果而可能拥有或交换的特定能力或才能 [G211]。\n- **价值流**：为客户、利益相关者或最终用户创造整体结果的端到端增值活动集合的表示 [G178]。开发业务场景时，指特定行业企业为市场交付有价值产品或服务而执行的一组活动。\n- **价值主张**：对客户购买并使用你的产品和/或服务将获得的具体结果的清晰陈述，聚焦成果，以客户易于理解和记住的简明方式表达，并应缓解其痛点。业务场景并不显式记录价值主张，但对解决方案提供方而言，理解客户业务场景的重要性怎么强调都不为过。\n\n业务场景通过若干阶段开发，以形成、验证并细化驱动架构工作的业务需求前提。每个阶段由规划、收集信息、分析信息、记录结果与评审结果等步骤组成（图 3-2）。每个阶段中，业务场景各要素依次改进；细化阶段决定是认为场景已完成并进入 TOGAF ADM 下一阶段，还是需要进一步细化——判断标准是“当前业务场景是否适合把需求传递到架构过程下游”。\n\n图 3-2：开发业务场景的阶段与步骤。原图、图元与当前关系解释读取本节 structured_references。\n\n这三个业务场景开发阶段及其步骤详见图 3-2 和第 3.2 节。\n\n> 编者说明：这里同时存在三个不同层次：识别场景五要素的六个工作事项、每阶段重复的五个步骤，以及前提形成/初步验证/细化三个开发阶段。它们不能合并成一条十几个节点的唯一强制顺序。",

  "translation_zh": "收集步骤针对图 3-1 各领域收集信息，目标是获得有效数据以塑造、确认和/或否定驱动工作的前提。若组织已有信息收集程序与实践（如为战略规划收集信息），应酌情使用，可在业务场景工作坊中或替代工作坊。\n\n可采用多种技术：信息研究、定性分析、定量分析、问卷、信息请求等。在面对面工作坊之前，应尽可能“离线”收集并预处理信息。例如，信息请求可包括索取战略与运营计划；此类文档通常极具洞察力，但所含信息通常需要大量预处理。若可能，可用这些信息在工作坊前生成业务场景初稿，以增进架构师的理解与信心，并提升工作坊对参与者的价值。\n\n收集信息的一个非常有用的方式是举办**业务场景工作坊**：由业务场景顾问引导一小群精选的业务代表回答一系列问题，以引出与架构工作所处理问题相关的信息。与会者必须从组织业务与技术高层中精心挑选，重要的是能且愿意坦诚开放地提供信息。若已有业务场景草案（例如通过本步骤预处理信息形成），工作坊也可用于评审草案状态。\n\n有时需要多次工作坊：有时把业务侧信息收集与技术侧分开，有时只是为了从更多人处获得更多信息。\n\n收集信息时，架构师可通过获取“真实世界案例”大大增强业务场景；引用真实案例时，应注意保持相关方匿名，避免指责。\n\n收集步骤可考虑的活动包括：\n\n- 拟定应回答的问题；\n- 收集公开可用数据或开展早期问卷；\n- 预处理公开数据（注意耗时）；\n- 基于公开数据形成关键要素的“稻草人”理解；\n- 针对缺口更新问题；\n- 准备引导收集机制的全部材料；\n- 实施所选信息收集机制；\n- 举办一次或多次工作坊（若选择工作坊方式）：\n  - 就问题主题与范围取得利益相关者总体一致；\n  - 从利益相关者中取得支持者，并请其提供代表名单；\n  - 工作坊前向受邀者发送邀请与问题；\n  - 确定引导者与记录员；\n  - 制定议程；\n  - 制作工作坊材料（含“稻草人”业务场景）；\n  - 布置场地（白板纸、U 形桌、白板、会议接入等）；\n  - 举办工作坊并以电子方式记录全部信息。",

  ],
  "translation_zh": "分析步骤是真正开展大量业务架构工作之处，目标是形成业务场景关键要素的统一视图：处理并记录所收集信息，并创建（通常为可视化的）模型来表现信息。\n\n分析步骤利用业务场景顾问的知识与经验，借助过往工作形成描绘所捕获信息所需的模型。注意：产出的模型与文档未必逐字复述访谈内容，而是按真实底层需求进行过滤与转译。\n\n分析步骤中重要的是保持业务场景关键要素之间的联系。一种有助于保持联系的技术是创建矩阵，把业务流程与以下各项关联：\n\n- 利益相关方群体；\n- 人的参与者；\n- 计算机参与者；\n- 问题；\n- 目标。\n\n如此，业务流程成为绑定焦点——这在多数情况下很合理，因为所追求的通常是业务流程改进。\n\n分析步骤可考虑的活动包括：\n\n- 把所有原始数据集中一处并锁定为只读；\n- 为每个关键要素建立单独电子表格收集相关数据；\n- 把原始数据复制到相应电子表格的原始数据列；\n- 对文本数据进行迭代转换与归一化（语义处理）：\n  - 把复合陈述拆为单点；\n  - 通过亲和分析、综合与抽象，把原始数据转换为归一化清单；\n  - 进一步亲和分析，为清单创建类别；\n  - 记录每一步转换；\n- 对可计算数据建立汇总机制——进行计算；\n- 新建电子表格，建立关联全部关键要素的矩阵；\n- 开展业务与能力分析，生成一组业务与技术需求；\n- 对每个关键要素的答案评估完整性与正确性；\n- 酌情为所收集的数据起草模型。",

text:
3.3.1 前提形成阶段
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:3.3.1",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0024",
  "section_number": "3.3.1",
  "title_en": "3.3.1. Premise Formulation Phase",
  "title_zh": "3.3.1 前提形成阶段",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    24
  ],
  "translation_zh": "每项工作都始于某种问题概念及处理该问题的方法。例如，企业可能有系统割裂、无法通信的问题，并认为可通过实施 ERP 系统解决。这一主张就是前提。该前提实质上预设了一个未明说问题的答案——ERP 真能减少我所有系统无法互操作的问题吗？有时该前提与未明说的问题未被审视，这可能是关键错误。本阶段试图理解前提及需审视的未明说问题，确保架构项目切中要害。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G176:p0024:c014",
      "pdf_page": 24,
      "content_index_zero_based": 14,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "3.3.1. Premise Formulation Phase",
      "source_block_ids": [

      "pdf_page": 24,
      "content_index_zero_based": 15,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Every effort starts with some notion of a problem and an approach to dealing with a problem. For example, an enterprise might have the problem of disparate systems that do not communicate and they may have the notion that to address the problem they may implement an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. This proposition is an example of a premise. This premise in essence presumes an answer to an unstated question – do ERPs actually reduce my problem of all my systems that do not interoperate? Sometimes this premise and the unstated question do not get examined, which can be a critical mistake. In this phase we attempt to develop an understanding of the premise and unstated question or questions that need to be examined to ensure an architecture project is on point.",

text:
4. 业务场景的内容
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:4",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0037",
  "section_number": "4",
  "title_en": "4. Contents of a Business Scenario",
  "title_zh": "4. 业务场景的内容",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    27,
    28
  ],
  "translation_zh": "业务场景文档应包含场景的全部重要细节：捕获并排序处理情境的关键步骤与参与者交互；声明所有参与者的相关信息，特别是各参与者的不同职责、系统正常运作前必须满足的关键前提条件，以及服务达到可接受质量的技术要求。\n\n内容主要有两类：图形（模型）与描述性文本。二者各司其职：\n\n- 业务场景**模型**以图形捕获业务与技术视图，帮助理解；具体关联参与者与交互，并为确认具体需求提供起点；\n- 业务场景**文档**以文本记录细节。典型目录如下：\n\n```\n版本历史\n目录\n前言（总体背景与为何使用业务场景方法）\n1. 执行摘要\n   1.1 “那又怎样？”——为什么需要本业务场景？\n   1.2 谁将使用本业务场景？“以便……”——如何使用？\n2. 文档路线图\n3. 业务场景\n   3.1 场景背景\n   3.2 场景目的\n   3.3 术语定义\n   3.4 业务场景的开发\n4. 业务环境\n   4.1 利益相关方群体\n   4.2 业务驱动因素\n   4.3 业务流程（即价值流）\n   4.4 人的参与者与角色\n   4.5 与流程的关系\n5. 技术环境\n   5.1 技术流程（即价值流）\n   5.2 计算机参与者与角色\n   5.3 与流程的关系\n6. 业务场景分析\n   6.1 问题摘要\n   6.2 问题/痛点\n   6.3 期望成果\n   6.4 信息流\n   6.5 需求\n   6.6 原则与约束\n   6.7 导出的架构模型\n7. 标准化的优先领域\n   7.1 按流程领域的优先级\n   7.2 建议的起点\n8. 小结与下一步\n附录 A  补充信息\n附录 B  参考文档\n附录 C  工作坊记录\n附录 D  致谢\n```\n\n> 编者说明：这是一份典型目录模板。表内 Business Process (aka Value Stream) 和 Technical Process (aka Value Stream) 按原文保留，不据此把业务流程与价值流在全部 TOGAF 业务架构中合并为同一概念；G178 对价值流阶段与业务流程的映射另有说明。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G176:p0027:c000",
      "pdf_page": 27,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "4. Contents of a Business Scenario",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0027:b001"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        34.086,
        416.234,
        64.38

      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The documentation of a Business Scenario should contain all the important details about the scenario. It should capture, and sequence, the critical steps and interactions between actors that address the situation. It should also declare all the relevant information about all actors, specifically: the different responsibilities of the actors; the key pre-conditions that have to be met prior to proper system functionality; and the technical requirements for the service to be of acceptable quality.",
      "source_block_ids": [

text:

  "section_number": "5",
  "title_en": "5. Contributions to the Business Scenario",

    29
  ],
  "translation_zh": "必须认识到，业务场景的创建并非架构师的专属领域。如前所述，业务线管理者与其他利益相关者要参与，以确保准确捕获业务目标；此外，视组织与 IT 供应商的关系，供应商也可参与，以确保准确捕获技术解决方案的角色，并确保与供应商的沟通。\n\n通常，业务管理层的参与在早期探索与捕获业务问题时最大；架构师的参与在后期描述架构解决方案时最大。同样，若供应商参与业务场景过程，客户方（业务管理层与企业架构师）的参与在早期最大，供应商的参与在后期探索与捕获具体技术方案角色时最大。该概念如图 5-1 所示。\n\n供应商的 IT 架构师或许能够协助企业 IT 架构师把供应商产品集成到企业架构中；这种协助很可能落在图 5-1 时间线的中部。\n\n图 5-1：业务场景的相对贡献。原图、图元与当前关系解释读取本节 structured_references。",

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "It is important to realize that the creation of a Business Scenario is not solely the province of the architect. As mentioned previously, business line management and other stakeholders in the enterprise are involved to ensure that the business goals are accurately captured. In addition, depending on the relationship that an organization has with its IT vendors, the latter also may be involved to ensure that the roles of technical solutions are also accurately captured, and to ensure communication with the vendors.",

    30

  "translation_zh": "业务场景在 TOGAF ADM 循环的初始阶段——**阶段 A：架构愿景** [C220]——最为突出：此时业务场景用于定义相关业务需求，并与业务管理层及其他利益相关者建立共识。业务场景也用于**业务架构阶段**，以直接从业务的高层需求推导架构特征。\n\n业务需求在整个 ADM 生命周期的所有阶段都会被引用，见图 6-1。\n\n图 6-1：需求在整个 TOGAF ADM 中的相关性。原图及其阶段关系读取本节 structured_references。\n\n若需要推导需求，业务场景也可用于任何 ADM 阶段。例如，可用于预备阶段，以定义建立企业架构能力所需的需求。\n\n由于业务需求在 ADM 循环的所有阶段都很重要，业务场景技术通过确保业务需求本身完整、正确，在 TOGAF ADM 中扮演重要角色。",

text:
7.1 一般指南
{

    31

  "translation_zh": "利益相关者（如业务管理者、最终用户）会告诉你他们想要什么，但作为架构师，你仍必须自行理解业务，因此必须了解系统中最重要的参与者。如果利益相关者并不清楚自己想要什么：\n\n- 花时间观察并记录他们今天的工作方式；\n- 以日后可用的方式组织信息；\n- 从领域专家处发掘关键业务规则；\n- 始终聚焦于需要达成什么，以及如何达成。\n\n这项工作为从业务需求到技术解决方案的推理链提供锚点。开始时勤勉、批判，日后会有回报。",

8.1 文本文档
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:8.1",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0051",
  "section_number": "8.1",
  "title_en": "8.1. Textual Documentation",
  "title_zh": "8.1 文本文档",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    34
  ],
  "translation_zh": "有效的业务场景文档需要在“确保细节可获取”与“防止细节喧宾夺主、压垮读者”之间取得平衡。为此，业务场景文档应把主要发现放在正文，把细节放在附录。\n\n在附录中：\n\n- 捕获业务场景的全部重要细节：\n  - 情境描述与理由；\n  - 所有度量；\n  - 所有参与者角色与子度量；\n  - 所有所需服务；\n- 捕获处理该情境的参与者之间的关键步骤，并对交互排序；\n- 声明所有参与者的相关信息：\n  - 划分参与者的职责；\n  - 列出系统正常运作前必须满足的前提条件；\n  - 提供服务达到可接受质量的技术要求。\n\n在业务场景正文中：\n\n- 对附录中的细节进行概括，提炼所有相关数据。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G176:p0034:c001",
      "pdf_page": 34,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "8.1. Textual Documentation",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0034:b002"
      ],
      "bbox": [

        76.214,

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Effective Business Scenario documentation requires a balance between ensuring that the detail is accessible, and preventing it from overshadowing the results and overwhelming the reader. To this end, the Business Scenario document should have the main findings in the body of the document and the details in appendices.",

text:
9.2 SMART具体目标的重要性
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:9.2",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0055",
  "section_number": "9.2",
  "title_en": "9.2. The Importance of SMART Objectives",
  "title_zh": "9.2 SMART具体目标的重要性",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    36
  ],
  "translation_zh": "目标不仅要以一般性措辞陈述，还需附加具体度量，使其如前述那样成为 SMART。\n\n为此投入的精力将使架构演进周期的发起人获得更大的清晰度。它会在循环的每一步把拟议解决方案更紧密地引向目标，从而带来回报。对组织内不同利益相关者以及供应商和顾问而言，有一把衡量适用性的清晰标尺极为有益。若做得好，可用 ADM 把具体决策追溯到评价准则，从而给出其正当性依据。\n\n下文目标改编自以往版本 TOGAF 标准中的目标。它们是目标的类别，每类附有一组可能的具体目标。每个具体目标都应以针对具体任务的度量与指标使其 SMART。然而，由于实际工作取决于具体的架构项目，不可能提供适用于任何项具体目标通用 SMART 具体目标清单。\n\n因此，这里只提供一些 SMART 具体目标示例。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G176:p0036:c004",
      "pdf_page": 36,
      "content_index_zero_based": 4,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "9.2. The Importance of SMART Objectives",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0036:b010"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        247.694,
        404.334,
        272.48
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G176:s0055"
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0036:c005",
      "pdf_page": 36,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Not only must goals be stated in general terms, but also specific measures need to be attached to them to make them SMART, as described earlier.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0036:b011",
        "G176:p0036:b012"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        282.23,
        563.76,
        312.29
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0036:c006",
      "pdf_page": 36,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The amount of effort spent in doing this will lead to greater clarity for the sponsors of the architecture evolution cycle. It will pay back by driving proposed solutions much more closely toward the goals at each step of the cycle. It is extremely helpful for the different stakeholders inside the organization, as well as for suppliers and consultants, to have a clear yardstick for measuring fitness-for-purpose. text:
9.2.1 使具体目标符合SMART的示例
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:9.2.1",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0056",
  "section_number": "9.2.1",
  "title_en": "9.2.1. Example of Making Objectives SMART",
  "title_zh": "9.2.1 使具体目标符合SMART的示例",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    36,
    37
  ],
  "translation_zh": "在下文“提高用户生产率”这一总目标标题下，有一个提供“一致的用户界面”的具体目标，其描述如下：\n\n“一致的用户界面将确保所有用户可访问的功能与服务，无论应用或站点，都以相似、可预测的方式呈现和运行。这将带来更高的效率与更少的用户错误，进而可能降低恢复成本。”\n\n要使该具体目标 SMART，我们依次询问它是否具体、可度量、可行动、现实、有时限，然后对该具体目标作相应补充。\n\n以下是对该具体目标按这些标准所作的分析：\n\n- **具体**：提供“一致的用户界面，确保所有用户可访问的功能与服务无论应用或站点都以相似、可预测的方式呈现和运行”这一具体目标相当具体；但第二句所列的度量可以更具体。\n- **可度量**：如上所述，该具体目标可度量，但可以更具体；第二句可修改为（例如）：“这将使用户效率提高 10%、订单录入用户错误减少 20%，进而可能使订单录入成本降低 5%。”\n- **可行动**：该具体目标看起来确实可行动；显然必须提供用户界面的一致性，而这可以由负责向用户设备提供用户界面的人来处理。\n- **现实**：提供“一致的用户界面，确保所有用户可访问的功能与服务无论应用或站点都以相似、可预测的方式呈现和运行”这一具体目标可能并不现实；考虑到当今用户端使用 PDA 的情况，我们可能需要补充该具体目标，以确保下游开发人员不会不适当地设计出妨碍使用新技术的方案——该具体目标可改写为“跨越提供类似功能的用户界面设备的一致用户界面，确保……”\n- **有时限**：所述具体目标没有时限；要有时限，该具体目标可改写为“到第三季度末，提供一致的用户界面……”\n\n上述分析得出一个更接近如下的 SMART 具体目标（再次提醒，这只是示例）：\n\n“到第三季度末，在提供类似功能的各类用户界面设备上提供一致的用户界面，确保所有用户可访问的功能与服务在使用这些设备时，无论应用或站点，都以相似、可预测的方式呈现和运行。这将使用户效率提高 10%、订单录入用户错误减少 20%，进而可能使订单录入成本降低 5%。”\n\n> 示例边界：第三季度末、效率提高 10%、订单录入错误减少 20%、成本可能降低 5% 都是说明如何形成 SMART 具体目标的示例，未成为任何当前项目的实际基线、承诺或已达成效果。PDA 也是原文保留的历史设备示例。",

text:
9.3.6 目标：提高 IT 组织的有效性
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:9.3.6",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0063",
  "section_number": "9.3.6",
  "title_en": "9.3.6. Goal: Improve Effectiveness of IT Organization",
  "title_zh": "9.3.6 目标：提高 IT 组织的有效性",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    39
  ],
  "translation_zh": "IT 组织有效性可通过以下具体目标实现：\n\n- 增加新项具体目标上线数量；\n- 缩短新项目上线时间；\n- 降低新项目上线成本；\n- 减少新项目上线时的服务连续性损失；\n- **通用开发**：多个业务领域共用的应用只开发或采购一次并复用，而非由各业务领域分别开发；\n- **开放系统环境**：建立基于标准的通用运行环境，可在全组织范围内接纳新标准、新技术与新应用；该基于标准的环境将为通用应用开发提供基础，并促进软件复用；\n- **产品使用**：尽可能使用硬件无关的现成产品来满足需求，以减少对定制开发的依赖，并降低开发与维护成本；\n- **软件复用**：对于必须定制开发的应用，开发可移植应用将减少软件开发量，并增加可供其他系统复用的软件库存；\n- **资源共享**：数据处理资源（硬件、软件与数据）将由所有需要这些资源服务的用户共享——资源共享将在安全与运营考虑的语境下实现。",

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Open systems environment: a standards-based common operating environment, which accommodates the injection of new standards, technologies, and applications on an organization- wide basis, will be established; this standards-based environment will provide the basis for development of common applications and facilitate software re-use",

      "content_index_zero_based": 15,

      "text_en": "• Resource sharing: data processing resources (hardware, software, and data) will be shared by all users requiring the services of those resources – resource sharing will be accomplished in the context of security and operational considerations",

section_title: 9.3.11 目标：降低生命周期成本
text:
9.3.11 目标：降低生命周期成本
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:9.3.11",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0068",
  "section_number": "9.3.11",
  "title_en": "9.3.11. Goal: Reduce Lifecycle Costs",
  "title_zh": "9.3.11 目标：降低生命周期成本",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    40,
    41
  ],
  "translation_zh": "生命周期成本可通过上述多数具体目标降低。此外，以下具体目标直接针对生命周期成本的降低：\n\n- **减少重复**：以互联开放系统取代孤立系统与自动化孤岛，将减少重叠功能、数据重复与不必要的冗余，因为开放系统可以共享数据与其他资源；\n- **降低软件维护成本**：减少组织所用软件的数量与种类，将降低软件维护的工作量与成本——使用标准现成软件将进一步降低成本，因为此类软件的供应商把产品维护成本分摊到更大的用户群；\n- **增量替换**：共享基础设施组件的通用接口允许分阶段替换或升级，而对运营的干扰最小；\n- **降低培训成本**：通用系统与一致的人机接口（HCI）将降低培训成本。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G176:p0040:c014",
      "pdf_page": 40,
      "content_index_zero_based": 14,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "9.3.11. Goal: Reduce Lifecycle Costs",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0040:b032"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        682.719,
        273.868,
        700.62
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G176:s0068"
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0040:c015",
      "pdf_page": 40,
      "content_index_zero_based": 15,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Lifecycle costs can be reduced through most of the objectives discussed above. In addition, the following objectives directly address reduction of lifecycle costs:",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0040:b033",
        "G176:p0040:b034"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        710.87,
        563.76,
        740.93
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0041:c000",
      "pdf_page": 41,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Reduced duplication: replacement of isolated systems and islands of automation with interconnected open systems will lead to reductions in overlapping functionality, data duplication, and unneeded redundancy because open systems can share data and other resources",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0041:b001",
        "G176:p0041:b002",
        "G176:p0041:b003"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        36.75,
        557.789,
        82.59
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0041:c001",
      "pdf_page": 41,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Reduced software maintenance costs: reductions in the quantity and variety of software used in the organization will lead to reductions in the amount and cost of software maintenance – use of standard off-the-shelf software will lead to further reductions in costs since vendors of such software distribute their product maintenance costs across a much larger user base",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0041:b004",
        "G176:p0041:b005",

9.3.12 目标：提高安全性

  "translation_zh": "组织信息的安全性可通过以下具体目标提高：\n\n- **一致的应用安全接口**：一致的安全接口与程序将减少开发应用时的错误并提高应用可移植性；并非所有应用都需要同一套安全特性，但所使用的任何特性都应在各应用间保持一致；\n- **一致的用户安全接口**：安全特性的通用用户界面将减少在系统间切换时的学习时间；\n- **安全独立性**：如果架构具有良好的分层，应用部署可以使用适合特定环境的安全策略与机制；\n- 与安全问题相关的服务台呼叫减少 25%；\n- 网络中检测到的“误报”减少 20%（误报是指看似可采取行动的安全事件、但实际上是虚惊一场的事件）。\n\n> 示例边界：25% 与 20% 是本节列出的可能具体目标，尚需按项目确定基线、统计口径、时限与责任；并非全行业最低门槛或当前项目结果。",

10. 角色
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:10",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0071",
  "section_number": "10",
  "title_en": "10. Roles",
  "title_zh": "10. 角色",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    42
  ],
  "translation_zh": "开发业务场景需要填补多个角色。有些角色可由同一人担任，因此角色数量之和并不意味着需要那么多人。人员配置应在规划步骤中完成：\n\n- **项目经理**（Project Manager）：规划、执行并监控项目，使业务场景在规定时间与预算内形成文档并经过评审；\n- **业务场景顾问**（Business Scenario Consultant）：引导项目朝正确方向推进，以产出高质量的业务场景；\n- **业务场景分析师**（Business Scenario Analyst）：运用数据收集与分析技术，形成对业务场景各要素的共识视图；\n- **业务场景作者**（Business Scenario Author）：对业务场景作出忠实、客观的叙述性描述；\n- **业务场景编辑**（Business Scenario Editor）：把草稿加工成配得上 The Open Group 品牌标识的高质量可发布文档；\n- **业务场景引导者**（Business Scenario Facilitator）：主持编排良好的会议与工作坊，使与会者满意且有所收获；\n- **领域专家贡献者**（SME Contributors）：就拟议前提相关的特定主题提供专家建议与内容；\n- **领域专家评审者**（SME Reviewers）：评审业务场景文档并提出客观、建设性的建议；\n- **东道主**（Host）：为参与者提供受欢迎的环境，体现该项工作的推动力，让与会者放心开放；\n- **发起人**（Sponsor）：代表高管层“买方”，说明推进该项工作的重要性，让与会者放心其将支持这项工作及后续跟进；\n- **工作坊主问者与次问者**（Workshop Primary and Secondary Questioner）：提出有计划的探询性问题与追问，引出与主题相关的信息；\n- **工作坊记录员**（Workshop Recorders）：忠实记录工作坊与会议的问题答案与笔记。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G176:p0042:c000",

      "content_index_zero_based": 0,

There are roles that can be filled by the same person, so the sum of the roles means you may not need that many people. Configuring the people to perform the roles is something that should be done in the Planning step:",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0042:b002",
        "G176:p0042:b003",
        "G176:p0042:b004",
        "G176:p0042:b005"

    {

      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Project Manager: plan, execute, and monitor a project that results in a documented and vetted Business Scenario in time and on budget",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0042:b006",
        "G176:p0042:b007"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        148.85,

    {
      "id": "G176:p0042:c003",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Business Scenario Consultant: guide the project so that it is moving in the right direction to result in a quality Business Scenario",

section_title: 12.1 关于主动倾听与反思性倾听
text:
12.1 关于主动倾听与反思性倾听
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:12.1",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0080",
  "section_number": "12.1",
  "title_en": "12.1. On Active and Reflective Listening",
  "title_zh": "12.1 关于主动倾听与反思性倾听",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    48
  ],
  "translation_zh": "- 当你希望确保某人被听到——不仅被你，而是被所有人听到时使用。\n- 主动倾听（据 Wikipedia®）：\n  - 一种用于咨询、培训与冲突解决的沟通技巧，要求倾听者把听到的内容反馈给说话者，即用自己的话重述或复述所听内容，以确认听到的内容，并进一步确认双方的理解。\n- 反思性倾听（据 Wikipedia）：\n  - 一种包含两个关键步骤的沟通策略：先设法理解说话者的想法，再把该想法回馈给说话者，以确认已正确理解；它试图“重构客户的所思所感，并转达这种理解”。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G176:p0048:c014",
      "pdf_page": 48,
      "content_index_zero_based": 14,

    {
      "id": "G176:p0048:c017",
      "pdf_page": 48,
      "content_index_zero_based": 17,

      "text_en": "◦A communication technique used in counseling, training, and conflict resolution, which",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0048:b019"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        74.954,
        449.45,
        521.743,
        463.73

      "pdf_page": 48,
      "content_index_zero_based": 18,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "requires the listener to feed back what they hear to the speaker, by way of re-stating or paraphrasing what they have heard in their own words, to confirm what they have heard and, moreover, to confirm the understanding of both parties",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0048:b020",
        "G176:p0048:b021",
        "G176:p0048:b022"
      ],
      "bbox": [

      "text_en": "• Reflective listening from Wikipedia:",

      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        518.57,
        246.095,
        532.85
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0048:c020",
      "pdf_page": 48,
      "content_index_zero_based": 20,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "◦A communication strategy involving two key steps: seeking to understand a speaker’s idea, then",
      "source_block_ids": [

{

    50

  "translation_zh": "- 当你想了解人们真正愿意把资源投入何处时使用。\n- 使用假钱或“点数”。\n- 给每人一个预算：\n  - 不能超预算花费；\n  - 可投给一项或多项；\n  - 如有其他规则，应事先宣布。\n- 请参与者把预算分配到一份清单上：\n  - 可匿名进行（首选）；\n  - 使其真实：请每个人准备好为自己的分配辩护，就像向老板辩护一样。\n- 汇总预算。\n- 公布结果并讨论。",

13. 小结
{
  "id": "G176:chapter-review:13",
  "source_section_id": "G176:s0088",
  "section_number": "13",
  "title_en": "13. Summary",
  "title_zh": "13. 小结",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    52
  ],
  "translation_zh": "业务场景有助于解决高管面临的一个最常见问题：使重大转型（例如由 IT 变革支撑的转型）与业务对齐。\n\n任何重大项目的成功，都以它与业务需求的关联程度、以及它能否可证明地支持并使能企业达成业务成果来衡量。业务场景方法是一项重要技术，可用于定义企业架构的多个阶段，或支持任何其他重大项目，以直接从业务的高层需求推导架构特征。业务场景用于帮助识别并理解业务需求，从而导出架构开发乃至最终解决方案必须处理的业务需求。\n\n然而，重要的是记住：**业务场景只是工具，不是目的**。它们是更大范围的架构与下游开发过程的一部分，并为该过程提供使能。架构师应使用它们，但不应迷失其中。关键是保持聚焦——警惕“功能蔓延”（feature creep），处理那些往往能带来最大价值的最重要问题。",

        185.41,

    {

      "pdf_page": 52,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Business Scenarios help to address one of the most common issues facing executives: aligning significant transformation, such as those supported by IT changes, with the business.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0052:b002",
        "G176:p0052:b003"

    },
    {
      "id": "G176:p0052:c002",
      "pdf_page": 52,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The success of any major project is measured by the extent to which it is linked to business requirements, and demonstrably supports and enables the enterprise to achieve its business outcomes. The Business Scenario method is an important technique that may be used at various stages of defining an Enterprise Architecture, or in support of any other major project, to derive the characteristics of the architecture directly from the high-level requirements of the business. Business Scenarios are used to help identify and understand business needs, and thereby to derive the business requirements that the architecture development, and ultimately the solution, has to address.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G176:p0052:b004",
        "G176:p0052:b005",
        "G176:p0052:b006",
        "G176:p0052:b007",

        "G176:p0052:b010"

      "bbox": [

        563.76,
        226.25

      "pdf_page": 52,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "However, it is important to remember that Business Scenarios are just a tool, not the objective. They are a part of, and enable, the larger process of architecture and downstream development. The architect should use them, but not get lost in them. The key is to stay focused – watch out for “feature creep”, and address the most important issues that tend to return the greatest value.",

  "translation_zh": "TOGAF® 系列指南说明如何使用 TOGAF 标准，以及如何裁剪以满足具体需要。\n\n系列指南预期是 TOGAF 标准中发展最快的部分，定位为标准的指导部分。TOGAF 基础内容预期保持长期稳定，而使用指导可针对行业、架构风格、用途与问题。例如，扩展企业转型所需的利益相关者、关注点、视图与支撑模型，可能与内部 IT 环境迁移到云所需内容显著不同；两者都使用 ADM，都从架构愿景开始，开发目标架构，并走向实施与迁移计划。TOGAF 基础内容是跨行业、领域和风格的必要支架。",
