      "pdf_page": 20,
      "content_index_zero_based": 9,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Top-down, the Enterprise Strategic Architecture provides a high-level view of the area of the enterprise impacted by change. It enables understanding of the overall strategic direction of the enterprise at a high level, and must be sufficiently broad to establish the context within which the segments and capabilities fit. It is necessary to plan and design the entire endeavor, and to avoid unanticipated consequences.",

      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The middle layer, the Segment Architectures, typically provide direction at the portfolio, program, or product level. These large-scale segments are often aligned to natural boundaries of functionality.",

section_title: 4.1. 不同的详细程度支撑敏捷
text:
"content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The bottom layer, the Capability Architectures, are detailed descriptions of (increments of) business capabilities [G193]. These may align to delivery sprints, or multiple sprints may be needed to deliver a capability. They are sufficiently detailed to be handed to developers for action. Sprints may occur at any level, but are most commonly associated with the delivery of capabilities or increments of capability. Sprints can occur in parallel.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0021:b003",
        "G20F:p0021:b004",
        "G20F:p0021:b005",
        "G20F:p0021:b006",
        "G20F:p0021:b007"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        80.31,
        563.76,
        157.71
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0021:c002",
      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "A key consideration is that sprints are time-boxed and aimed at addressing a set of bounded objectives. The Capability Architecture increments should be tightly scoped to be achievable within sprint time boxes. More detailed guidance relating to sprints can be found in the TOGAF® Series Guide: Applying the TOGAF® ADM using Agile Sprints [G210].",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0021:b008",
        "G20F:p0021:b009",
        "G20F:p0021:b010",
        "G20F:p0021:b011",
        "G20F:p0021:b012",
        "G20F:p0021:b013"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        171.21,
        563.76,
        232.83
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0021:c003",
      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The higher-level Enterprise Strategic and Segment Architectures should show the relationships and dependencies between capabilities and capability increments and provide the framework for planning and design, and the management of risk. They then provide the information needed to assess the impact of a proposed change. The Capability Architectures then show the relationship between capability increments.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0021:b014",
        "G20F:p0021:b015",
        "G20F:p0021:b016",
        "G20F:p0021:b017",
        "G20F:p0021:b018"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        246.33,
        563.76,
        323.73
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0021:c004",
      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 4,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Bottom-up, there is feedback from the implementation of capability increments which influences the higher levels. The Capability, Segment, and Enterprise Strategic Architectures may evolve as a result of experience gained from the deployment of each capability (or capability increment).",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0021:b019",
        "G20F:p0021:b020",
        "G20F:p0021:b021"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        337.23,
        563.76,
        383.07
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0021:c005",
      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The Strategic Architecture is not static. It must evolve as the strategy of the enterprise evolves. In Agile enterprises, this will be more frequent than a “traditional” long-term strategic business plan.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0021:b022",
        "G20F:p0021:b023"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        396.57,
        563.76,
        426.63
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0021:c006",
      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "It is vital to have appropriate governance to maintain the link between the business needs, Enterprise Architectures, and the Agile solution developments of the enterprise.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0021:b024",
        "G20F:p0021:b025"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        440.13,
        563.76,
        470.19
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0021:c007",
      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Two major factors to achieving successful agility at an enterprise level are:",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0021:b026"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        483.69,
        421.326,
        497.97
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0021:c008",
      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 8,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "1. Managing the scope, understanding when a new capability is needed, how much of the enterprise is impacted, and how different parts of the enterprise interact",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0021:b027",
        "G20F:p0021:b028"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        52.676,
        511.47,
        554.322,

      ],

    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0021:c009",
      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 9,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "2. Having a sufficient understanding of the overall strategic direction of the enterprise, key business capabilities, and the relationships between them in order to minimize the risks of unanticipated consequences and piecemeal development, and identify any change which would detract from the overall strategy for the enterprise; this understanding facilitates an impact assessment of any proposed change",

        "G20F:p0021:b029",

text:
4.2. 过渡架构
{

  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0028",

  "pdf_pages": [
    22
  ],
  "translation_zh": "过渡架构是对架构在**架构上具有重要意义的某个时间点**之状态的正式描述（图 4-2），通常包含若干能力增量。它描述通往期望成果的路线图，并确保实施后整个系统的稳定性。在敏捷中，能力增量通常通过冲刺实现。过渡架构还通过帮助理解交付的增量状态来管理风险；过渡架构与向利益相关者释放业务价值相关。",

      "id": "G20F:p0022:c000",

      "pdf_page": 22,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "A Transition Architecture is a formal description of one state of the architecture at an architecturally significant point in time (see Figure 4-2), usually including a number of capability increments. It describes the roadmap to the desired outcome and ensures the stability of the complete system after its implementation. In Agile, the capability increments are usually implemented using sprints. Transition Architectures also provide a way of managing risk by helping to understand the incremental states of delivery. Transition Architectures are related to releases of business value to the stakeholders.",

text:
4.3. 构建敏捷企业架构的实用方法
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:4.3",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0029",
  "section_number": "4.3",
  "title_en": "4.3. A Practical Approach to Structuring Agile Enterprise Architecture",
  "title_zh": "4.3. 构建敏捷企业架构的实用方法",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    22,
    23,
    24
  ],
  "translation_zh": "通过 ADM 循环层级应用多层级方法的一种实用且经过验证的做法如图 4-3 所示。\n\n\n\n如前所述，TOGAF ADM 阶段不必按顺序推进。定义分段架构的活动可在战略架构中识别相关领域后立即开始；即便并非所有分段都已定义，也可在已识别的分段中启动架构工作。类似地，能力架构的定义不必等到所有分段架构完成；不同分段与能力的工作可并行推进。战略架构、分段架构与能力架构将在 4.4 节中进一步详细说明。\n\n开发能力架构获得的经验应影响更高层的分段架构；开发分段架构获得的经验应影响更高层的战略架构。\n\n敏捷交付团队应与架构师紧密协作，确保冲刺团队理解并遵守架构规格（可表达为护栏或跑道），并使未来架构迭代获得快速反馈。\n\n必须牢记大局，确保实施团队与总体战略保持一致。因此，需要在“提供足够细节以保持清晰与对齐”与“过早探索过多细节（前期大设计 BDUF）而缺乏交付冲刺反馈”之间取得平衡——这常被称为**最小可行架构**（MVA）。",

    {

      "content_index_zero_based": 5,

      "text_en": "A practical and proven approach to applying the multi-level approach through a hierarchy of ADM cycles is illustrated in Figure 4-3.",

    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0023:c001",
      "pdf_page": 23,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "As described in the previous section, TOGAF ADM phases do not have to proceed in sequence. The activities around defining Segment Architectures can start as soon as the relevant areas have been identified in the Strategic Architecture. Even if not all of these segments have been defined, architecture work can start in those that had already been identified. In a similar way, work on defining Capability Architectures need not wait until all Segment Architectures have been defined. Work on different segments and capabilities may proceed in parallel. The Strategic, Segment, and Capability Architectures are explained in more detail in Section 4.4.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0023:b002",
        "G20F:p0023:b003",
        "G20F:p0023:b004",

    {

      "pdf_page": 24,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Experience gained when developing a Capability Architecture should influence the higher-level Segment Architecture. Experience gained when developing a Segment Architecture should influence the higher-level Strategic Architecture.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0024:b001",
        "G20F:p0024:b002",

    {
      "id": "G20F:p0024:c001",
      "pdf_page": 24,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Agile delivery teams should collaborate closely with architects to ensure that the sprint teams understand and comply with architecture specifications (which may be expressed as guardrails or runways), and to enable rapid feedback to future architecture iterations.",

        "G20F:p0024:b004",

      "text_en": "It is important to keep in mind the big picture to ensure implementation teams remain aligned to the overall strategy. Therefore, a balance must be made between providing sufficient detail at each level, to give clarity and maintain alignment, versus exploring too much detail too soon (“Big Design Up Front” (BDUF)) without the benefit of feedback from delivery sprints. This is often referred to as the Minimum Viable Architecture.",

text:
4.4.1. 战略架构
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:4.4.1",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0031",
  "section_number": "4.4.1",
  "title_en": "4.4.1. Strategic Architecture",
  "title_zh": "4.4.1. 战略架构",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    24,
    25
  ],
  "translation_zh": "在敏捷企业中，战略架构是由 TOGAF ADM 阶段 A（架构愿景）支持的高层迭代。该迭代定义企业战略方向以支持决策，并可在阶段 B 中进一步细化以提供组织全景的高层视图；它还可用于识别所需的架构与解决方案交付能力。\n\n有时也需要覆盖 B、C、D 等其他 ADM 阶段，以更清晰地把控整个全景；此时迭代与架构描述应保持高层，不需要全部 ADM 阶段。\n\n该迭代为可并行交付的分段架构提供识别与基础。敏捷企业开展战略架构的关键优势：\n\n- 提供定义战略主题、史诗（epic）与驱动因素所需的组织语境理解；识别价值流、高层需求及战略方向与愿景的其他广泛特征。战略架构为低层架构提供语境；\n- 确认定义产品/服务/解决方案交付“护栏”的基础；\n- 识别交付整个事业所需的高层组织能力：人员技能、工具、管理工具、治理原则等；\n- 提供组织全景理解，以在涉及松耦合组件时塑造迁移规划路线图，并识别与实施相关团队之间的协作与集成；\n\n  在这些团队的形成过程中，需要考虑避免把组织的沟通结构作为团队结构的基础。建议的方法反而是考虑塑造企业的组织，使技术架构与业务架构同构（isomorphic）。\n\n- 为后续迭代所覆盖的不同分段（通常为功能或组织领域）定义待办列表提供输入。\n\n该迭代的输出用作定义各分段架构待办列表的输入。",

Strategic direction for the enterprise is defined in this iteration to support decision-making, and which may be further elaborated in Phase B to provide a high-level view of the organization landscape. It can also be used to identify required architecture and solution delivery capabilities.",

text:
4.4.2. 分段架构
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:4.4.2",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0032",
  "section_number": "4.4.2",
  "title_en": "4.4.2. Segment Architecture",
  "title_zh": "4.4.2. 分段架构",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    25,
    26
  ],
  "translation_zh": "分段架构通常是产品或业务解决方案的规格说明。它应是“刚好足够”的架构，以识别特性及功能与非功能需求——未必需要完成全部 ADM 阶段与步骤，只需确保成果达成的最低限度。多个此类迭代可由不同敏捷团队并行交付。交付团队应参与分段架构的定义，以开始建立对将交付解决方案的共同理解。\n\n关键优势：\n\n- 支持能力层待办列表的定义；\n- 识别能力/使能因素，以及交付产品/服务/解决方案所需的特性与功能；\n- 定义确保按愿景与业务目标交付价值所需的 KPI；\n- 最终成果应是为每个分段塑造产品与解决方案的足够架构。一个分段由一个或多个产品与 SBB 组成；应交付刚好足够的架构，以增强解决方案设计、性能与可用性，并为团队间设计与实施提供指导；\n- 该层规格应面向组合层的分组，以支持史诗、并行工程、持续交付与集成规划等敏捷概念。\n\n该层可产出产品原型或概念验证，以确认潜在的总体解决方案模式可行。分段迭代的输出是待办事项，作为敏捷团队开展产品与解决方案实施的基础。这与 1.1 节“实践性试验”一致：偏好动手尝试并从经验中学习。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0025:c004",
      "pdf_page": 25,
      "content_index_zero_based": 4,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "4.4.2. Segment Architecture",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0025:b013"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        277.029,
        219.073,
        294.93
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G20F:s0032"
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0025:c005",
      "pdf_page": 25,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "A Segment Architecture is typically the specification of the product or business solution. It should be just enough architecture to identify features and functional and non-functional requirements — it may not be necessary to complete all ADM phases and steps, only the minimum needed to ensure outcomes are met. Several of these iterations can be delivered concurrently by different Agile teams. Delivery teams should be engaged during the definition of Segment Architectures to begin to build a common understanding of the solution to be delivered.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0025:b014",
        "G20F:p0025:b015",
        "G20F:p0025:b016",
        "G20F:p0025:b017",
        "G20F:p0025:b018",
        "G20F:p0025:b019"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        305.18,
        563.76,
        398.36
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0025:c006",
      "pdf_page": 25,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Key advantages for an Agile enterprise doing Segment Architecture are:",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0025:b020"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        411.86,
        406.048,
        426.14
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0025:c007",
      "pdf_page": 25,
      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Support for the definition of Capability-level backlogs",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0025:b021"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        439.64,
        333.644,
        453.92
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0025:c008",
      "pdf_page": 25,
      "content_index_zero_based": 8,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Identify the capabilities/enablers and then the features and functionalities needed to deliver the product/service/solution",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0025:b022",
        "G20F:p0025:b023"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        467.42,
        545.618,
        497.48
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0025:c009",
      "pdf_page": 25,
      "content_index_zero_based": 9,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Define the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) needed ensure value is delivered in accordance with the vision and business objectives",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0025:b024",
        "G20F:p0025:b025"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        510.98,
        558.511,
        541.04
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0025:c010",
      "pdf_page": 25,
      "content_index_zero_based": 10,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• The final outcome should be the sufficient architecture to shape the products and solutions for every segment",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0025:b026",
        "G20F:p0025:b027"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        554.54,
        538.173,
        584.6
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0025:c011",
      "pdf_page": 25,
      "content_index_zero_based": 11,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "A segment consists of one or more products and SBBs. Just enough architecture should be delivered to enhance solution design, performance, and usability, and provide guidance for inter-team design and implementation.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0025:b028",
        "G20F:p0025:b029",
        "G20F:p0025:b030"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        66.24,
        598.1,
        563.76,
        643.94
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0025:c012",
      "pdf_page": 25,
      "content_index_zero_based": 12,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Specification at this level should be oriented to grouping things together at portfolio level to support Agile concepts that include epics, concurrent engineering, and planning for continuous delivery and integration of the target solution",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0025:b031",
        "G20F:p0025:b032",
        "G20F:p0025:b033"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        657.44,
        542.32,
        703.28
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0026:c000",
      "pdf_page": 26,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Prototypes of the products or proofs of concept may be produced at this level to confirm that potential overarching solution patterns are possible.",
      "source_block_ids": [

  "translation_zh": "能力架构是最低层的架构细节，旨在把分段架构进一步细化到交付团队可直接用于实施解决方案的程度。与分段架构一样，多个能力架构可并行开发。\n\n能力架构迭代支持基于架构规格定义路线图，考虑目标解决方案的不同要素与规格并处理相互依赖。在 DevOps 链中，能力架构为持续集成（CI）与持续部署（CD）提供直接输入。能力架构输出可能特定于某个特性交付、因而特定于某个交付团队（如某功能行为的定义），也可能横切多个特性与团队（如 API 管理方法的定义）。\n\n由一次冲刺甚至一组冲刺交付的能力架构，应按范围逐步、迭代地集成到交付管道中。\n\n关键优势：\n\n- 从更高层架构提供刚好足够的细节来定义实现，并在必要时反馈更新更高层；\n- 恰好及时（JIT）开发，为交付冲刺提供前置“解决方案跑道”，同时避免不必要的约束；\n- 定义并细化由不同敏捷团队实现的用户故事；\n- 支持解决方案部署的质量保证与合规活动；\n- 支持可追溯性，确认战略架构的原始目标正在达成。\n\n能力架构的最终成果是解决方案规格，敏捷团队将按架构指南、度量与合规考虑按需构建并部署。\n\n在此语境中，敏捷交付指以敏捷方式交付架构规格，以支持后续的敏捷实现（敏捷解决方案交付）。\n\n一个重要提醒：需要在战略、分段与能力架构中贯彻“快速失败”，因此应对所交付规格开展持续评审与回顾，及时做出调整。回顾的成功取决于跨层级协作与治理（下节详述），因此跨学科自主团队至关重要。关于回顾、冲刺规划与评审的更多细节，见《TOGAF® 系列指南：以敏捷冲刺应用 TOGAF® ADM》[G210] §3.2.2。\n\n因此，在能力架构层面、基于战略与分段架构提供的全景与愿景，任何类型解决方案的构思也可被设计并快速原型化，以在实施环境中或内部快速测试。这是保持积极的由外而内视角、汇集输入以形成有吸引力的新解决方案的好方法。为此，与跨学科团队合作非常重要，不仅要有技术视角或新产品，更要有业务视角。\n\n校订注：原文对G210的引用写作§3.2.2；本地G210版中DORP位于§3.3.2，§3.2无此下级章节。保留原引用并标记版本定位疑点。",

  "translation_zh": "架构治理对于确保解决方案保持在实现业务目标（参考战略层 KPI）与合规监管要求的轨道上必不可少；它还通过层层架构与解决方案实施确保整体事业的一体性。治理也是风险管理的关键组成部分：往往正是通过治理活动，局部变更的更广泛影响才被识别与处理；当低层或实施中出现意外困难时，治理还承担向上反馈的角色。\n\n治理的实际应用应是不同层级架构团队之间、架构师与交付团队之间的协作与持续努力。广义而言，治理者的角色更像是嵌入团队的智能顾问，而非偶尔造访的警察。治理不应推迟到实施前的最后一次迭代，否则敏捷方法的好处很可能因返工与延误而丧失。\n\n企业架构治理为敏捷架构提供的价值，是提供指导实施的原则与政策（战略层所述“护栏”）、标准与合规考虑；它还确保适当的治理结构与审批到位，且不制约敏捷开发的速度。同样，架构师在此更多扮演咨询角色，因为他们还应检查“刚好所需”的架构描述是否到位以指导进一步实施（避免 BDUF）。治理也是保持不同自主团队之间良好沟通与参与的关键，在给予交付自由的同时提供指导。",

4.5. ADM 层级与阶段映射到敏捷概念
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:4.5",

  "section_number": "4.5",
  "title_en": "4.5. ADM Levels and Phases Mapped to Agile Concepts",
  "title_zh": "4.5. ADM 层级与阶段映射到敏捷概念",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",

  "translation_zh": "如前所述，TOGAF ADM 可通过战略、分段与能力架构，在不同详细程度与变更层级上并行、分区地交付架构迭代，这些架构迭代也可使用 SAFe、Scrum 等技术来开发。\n\n敏捷技术认为，开发与交付工作可基于一个跨所有层级（业务、技术、解决方案、构建与交付）的集成团队，在单一连贯冲刺中推进，或跨图 4-4 所示各类边界（可能相连但风格明显不同）推进。具体安排取决于各企业的复杂性与规模以及敏捷方法的实施。\n\n\n\n应用 TOGAF ADM 时，每个规划与交付层级都可能循环经历 A 到 G 的全部阶段，但三个层级往往侧重周期中的特定要素。战略层更侧重预备阶段（若需变更架构能力）与阶段 A、B，以提供定义跨企业与战略变更时间跨度视图的基础，产生一系列称为“行动方案”（courses of action）的战略高层计划。\n\n敏捷技术通常用高层战略主题与企业产品组合待办列表的最高层来应对。该层必须有跨学科团队（业务与技术团队，以及创建、实施与运营团队）参与，以开发既满足企业业务目标、又可能可交付的企业架构。\n\n分段层侧重把行动方案划分到相关组织单元（基于对期望业务能力与价值流的理解，并遵循各企业选择的分区方法——能力/产品、服务/流程或职能等），以便有效、高效地组织交付变革的工作。若执行阶段 A、B 所获信息不足，则可能更强调进一步详细探索阶段 B、C、D。\n\n可按所选组织单元结构把工作分解给各层级的自组织团队，并通过阶段 C、D 的高层迭代为产品或解决方案交付提供更详细信息，深入更小的组织领域（分段）。该迭代的输出是反映大型或长期用户故事的史诗（Epic），以及基于分段的初始产品组合和/或待办列表。该层的输出可用于（必要时）测试和试验新产品，提供原型描述，以便在相关分段市场中检验想法。\n\n在能力层，通过阶段 B、C、D 识别更具体的、面向解决方案的架构规格（包括 ABB），覆盖待实现解决方案的功能与非功能方面。这些架构规格随后在阶段 E 与 F 中进一步开发，作为 SBB 的基础，并集成到期望的解决方案/服务/产品中。这些规格最终确定后，再制定相关合同，以指导其复用/构建/获取与部署。实施单元与能力增量对齐，交付特定成果，使每一“块”工作都为相关利益相关者与发起人产出经约定价值的实现。这种在最小能力层级上快速持续实施的方法，形成由可交付单元构成的过渡架构，类似敏捷风格方法中最低层待办列表里的冲刺。这一最小能力层级在敏捷风格方法中通常称为最小可行产品（MVP）。\n\n待办列表通常（在需要时）细化为相当于 Scrum 冲刺待办列表的概念，即可在数周内（最多一个月）准备实施的交付冲刺。这些冲刺将把相当于 TOGAF 阶段 A 和/或 B、C、D、E 的规格推进到实施。重点在于建立集成团队与环境，使进一步的设计、构建、实施与运营过程无缝互动，从而在最小可行产品的每个单元交付完成时实现持续集成与持续实施。\n\n能力层在阶段 G（实施治理）完成运营层面的收口。这确保经约定的合同已按合同协议交付预期能力，并确保运营和变更产品/解决方案/服务所需的所有信息被妥善创建、存储并可访问，以支持未来更快、更高质量的变更。能力层在阶段 H（架构变更管理）确认收益实现。这确保对运营与业务绩效进行评估，以确认价值确实已交付，且产品/解决方案/服务的用户对该能力增量的业务成果满意。它还进一步确保演进中或已完成的更广泛分段层和/或战略层变更项目，在规划变更时所设定的适当边界（或护栏）内运行。\n\n在某一时点，可能存在压力要求越过能力架构所定义的跑道末端继续推进。这会在未来为文档不足或架构上脱节的产品/解决方案/服务管理埋下问题。这是一种技术债，与任何债务一样，需要谨慎管理，以确保债务不会失控。这应在阶段 H（架构变更管理）中处理。",

      "id": "G20F:p0029:c000",
      "pdf_page": 29,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "In the Segment level, the focus is on partitioning the courses of action across the relevant organization units (based on an understanding of the desired business capabilities and value streams and following each enterprise’s chosen approach to partitioning — capability/product, service/process, or function etc.) such that the work of delivering the change can be effectively and efficiently organized. Where the information acquired by performing Phases A and B is insufficient for this activity there may be more emphasis on further exploring Phases B, C, and D in greater detail.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0029:b001",
        "G20F:p0029:b002",

    {
      "id": "G20F:p0029:c001",
      "pdf_page": 29,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Work can be approached by factoring work to self-organizing teams at various levels (in line with the chosen organization unit structure) along with a high-level iteration through Phases C and D, that provides more detailed information for the product or solution delivery, going deeper into smaller organization areas (segments). Outputs of this iteration are the Epics that reflect large or long-running user stories, and the segment-based initial portfolio and/or backlog. The output from this level can be used to test and experiment with new products (if necessary), delivering descriptions for prototypes to test ideas into the relevant segment market.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0029:b007",
        "G20F:p0029:b008",
        "G20F:p0029:b009",
        "G20F:p0029:b010",

        252.39
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0029:c002",
      "pdf_page": 29,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "In the Capability level, a more specific solution-oriented architecture specification, including the ABBs, is identified through Phases B, C, and D, covering both the functional and non-functional aspects of the solution to be implemented. These architecture specifications are then further developed in Phases E and F as the basis for the SBBs, and their integration into the desired solutions/services/products. These are finalized and their associated contracts are then developed to direct their reuse/acquisition/build and deployment. The implementation units are aligned with increments of capability that will deliver specific outcomes such that each “chunk” of work produces an implementation of agreed value with the relevant stakeholders and sponsors. This approach to fast continuous implementation at the smallest level of capability creates a Transition Architecture of deliverable units similar to the sprints in the lowest level of backlog in the Agile style approaches. This smallest level of capability is often referred to as Minimum Viable Product in Agile style approaches.",

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The backlogs are (if needed) usually refined down to an equivalent of the Scrum concept of a sprint backlog of deliverable sprints that will be ready for implementation in weeks, or at most one month. These sprints will take the specification from the equivalent of the TOGAF Phases A and/or B, C, D, and E through to implementation. section_title: 4.5. ADM 层级与阶段映射到敏捷概念
text:
"text_en": "The Capability level is operationally completed in Phase G, Implementation Governance. This ensures that the agreed contracts have delivered the expected capability, in line with the contractual agreements, and that all of the required information for operating and changing the product/solution/service is properly created, stored, and made accessible to support faster and higher quality change in the future. The Capability level confirms benefits realization in Phase H, Architecture Change Management. This ensures that operational and business performance is evaluated to confirm that the value has in fact been delivered and that the users of the product/solution/services are satisfied with the business outcomes of that capability increment. It further ensures that the evolving or completed wider Segment and/or Strategic-level change projects are operating within the appropriate boundaries (or guardrails) set up when planning the change.",

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "There may be pressure to move forward beyond the end of the runway defined by the Capability Architecture at a given point in time. This can store up problems in the management of poorly documented or architecturally dislocated products/solutions/services in the future. This is a type of technical debt, and like any debt, needs careful management to ensure that the debt does not get out of control. This should be addressed in Phase H, Architecture Change Management.",

  "status": "source-compared-revised",

  "translation_zh": "来自精益产品与流程开发的集合式并行工程（Set-Based Concurrent Engineering，SBCE）[LEI] 可通过调整 TOGAF 框架来容纳。《Open Agile Architecture™ 标准》[C208] 与 SAFe® 都提倡 SBCE 实践。在 SBCE 中，整体解决方案被划分为若干子系统，为每个子系统设定宽泛目标，并同时识别和开发多种达成这些目标的备选方案。备选设计集合随时间迭代评估，每一轮淘汰较弱选项，直至选出最终最强设计。对每个备选方案，都要做足够的架构工作，以恰当评估相互竞争的备选方案，确保作出良好决策。架构备选方案与细化通过 ADM 迭代循环与冲刺完成。每个备选方案都执行一次 ADM 迭代，迭代内只做足够评估该备选方案权衡的架构工作。选定某一备选方案后，再通过 ADM 迭代与冲刺进一步细化所选方法的架构。关于如何使用 TOGAF 标准处理备选方案的进一步说明，见 The Open Group TOGAF 标准——ADM 技术 [C220] 第 9 章“架构备选方案”。\n\n这些容纳 SBCE 的迭代循环支持敏捷交付风格。例如，分段架构可在敏捷冲刺中定义，其中每个冲刺都是一次 ADM 迭代循环。",

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Set-Based Concurrent Engineering (SBCE) from Lean Product and Process Development [LEI] can be accommodated by adapting the TOGAF framework. Both the Open Agile Architecture™ Standard [C208] and SAFe® promote the practice of SBCE. In SBCE, the overall solution is divided into a number of sub- systems, broad targets are established for each sub-system, and multiple alternatives for reaching those targets are identified and developed concurrently. The set of alternative designs is evaluated iteratively over time, eliminating weaker options in each iteration, until the final, strongest design is selected. For each alternative, enough architecture is done to properly assess the competing alternatives, ensuring that good decisions are made. Architectural alternatives and elaborations are done using ADM iteration cycles and sprints. An ADM iteration is done for each alternative, with only enough architecture done within the iteration to evaluate the trade-offs for that alternative. When an alternative is selected, ADM iterations and sprints are done to further elaborate the architecture for the selected approach. text:
4.7.1. 三种交付风格
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:4.7.1",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0038",
  "section_number": "4.7.1",
  "title_en": "4.7.1. The Three Delivery Styles",
  "title_zh": "4.7.1. 三种交付风格",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    31,
    32,
    33
  ],
  "translation_zh": "敏捷是三种可与 TOGAF 标准协同工作的宽泛生命周期交付方法之一。它们为以有效节奏交付变革、并响应业务转型意愿，提供了相称且受控的方法。然而，敏捷性不只是使用冲刺；而是基于企业需要，在多种方法之间取得恰当平衡。\n\n既有更快的方法（快速），也有更慢的方法（稳健）。通常，任何具有一定规模与影响的宏观变革（敏捷中的一组冲刺、TOGAF 标准中的一系列过渡）都会包含一系列工作包的迭代，而这些迭代往往涉及全部三种变革生命周期。还需注意，稳健方法在适当时纳入敏捷要素，敏捷方法在适当时纳入快速要素。它们本质上是根据具体变革的复杂性与规模嵌套使用的。\n\n表 4-1 展示了与各方法相关的项目特征画像。该表是一般性指南而非刚性陈述，用于为每个宏观/微观交付循环考虑有效方法；每个企业/变革活动将决定如何最好地推进该变革。敏捷产品管理将在第 5 章讨论。\n\n可大致识别的三种主要生命周期交付方法是：\n\n- **快速**（Rapid）——简单组件的近乎即时实现（例如扩展原型，如快速应用开发（RAD））\n- **敏捷**（Agile）——针对特定有界功能的快速组件交付循环（例如 Java™ 应用描述（JAD）、动态系统开发方法（DSDM®）、敏捷）\n- **稳健**（Robust，风险与架构驱动）——复杂、大规模组件的较长期交付，可跨分段或企业范围互操作（例如 PRINCE2 与 MSP 等受管理项目或项目群）\n\n**表 4-1：有特征的生命周期变革交付方法及其画像**\n\n| 特征 | 快速 | 敏捷 | 稳健 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 小规模 | 是 | 是 | 否 |\n| 大规模 | 否 | 否 | 是 |\n| 简单 | 是 | 是 | 否 |\n| 复杂 | 否 | 否 | 是 |\n| 已验证的技术 | 是 | 是 | 是 |\n| 新技术 | 否 | 是 | 是 |\n| 稳定业务流程 | 是 | 是 | 是 |\n| 变化中的业务流程 | 否 | 是 | 是 |\n| 已具备技能 | 是 | 是 | 是 |\n| 需要培养技能 | 否 | 是 | 是 |\n| 新解决方案 | 否 | 是 | 是 |\n| 扩展现有解决方案 | 是 | 是 | 是 |\n| 集成现有构建块 | 是 | 是 | 是 |\n| 集成现有运行服务 | 是 | 是 | 是 |\n| 短期变革视野 | 是 | 是 | 是 |\n| 长期变革视野 | 否 | 否 | 是 |\n| 时间驱动项目（较短时间框架） | 是 | 是 | 否 |\n| 时间驱动项目（较长时间框架） | 否 | 否 | 是 |\n| 成本驱动项目 | 是 | 是 | 是 |\n| 质量驱动项目 | 否 | 否 | 是 |\n| 功能驱动项目 | 否 | 是 | 是 |\n| 结构/架构驱动项目 | 否 | 否 | 是 |\n| 低风险 | 是 | 是 | 否 |\n| 高风险 | 否 | 否 | 是 |\n\n注意，对于任何具有一定规模或复杂度的项目，每一块（冲刺、迭代、阶段、过渡等）都可能需要不同方法，因此项目很可能根据具体情况综合采用所有这些方法。\n\n在多数变革中，会有相当数量（甚至更多）的过渡采用敏捷风格方法实施。偶尔需要纯粹的速度（快速）。在某些变革中，当变更伴随高风险或重大后果时，会选择真正审慎的（稳健）方法。当敏捷交付生命周期是最合适的方法时，它与 TOGAF 标准良好集成，所交付的冲刺代表标准中定义的、朝着演进和变化的目标架构推进的过渡。同样，TOGAF 标准并不抽象地规定哪种交付生命周期方法最适合宏观或微观迭代。相反，在其架构变更管理阶段，它提供了结构与控制，使企业能够真正敏捷，并为每种具体变革情境选择最佳方法。\n\n快速聚焦变革的概念是敏捷的基础，强大但并非唯一。节奏有很多种，不只有一种。通常，即使是最简单的功能，也需要许多相互依赖的要素就位才能有效运作。例如，在田径运动中有四种主要节奏：\n\n- 短跑\n- 中距离\n- 长距离\n- 马拉松\n\n每种节奏都有其适用情境。用错节奏不仅是不够好，往往意味着彻底失败。在任何一个项目中，高风险可能需要较慢的变革节奏，以确保每个要素的风险得到妥善管理；而较低风险则可能使解决方案更快实施。在任何变革项目中，不同迭代往往需要以不同节奏推进。预期是：每个迭代都应被识别为具有适当节奏，然后按该节奏组织交付。\n\n早期敏捷方法（如 Scrum）强调在短冲刺中以快节奏交付小型单元。（注意，后来的敏捷方法如 SAFe 已将范围扩大到包含更大交付单元、更多内容，并以不同节奏运作。）然而，这在许多情境下并不适用。在大型复杂、强耦合、有状态、偏悲观且受控的情境中（如核电站、飞机控制系统或不可否认性场景），可能需要许多团队参与，并要求相当程度的控制与指导。成功的军事组织中最重要的要素是后勤（组织、一致性与规模化交付——可能采用枢纽-辐射式架构，如高效货物配送），而不是突击队（突击队确有其用武之地，在适当情境下非常有效，但不适合规模化）——这是有原因的。\n\n校订注：本版原文把JAD展开为“Java™ Application Description”；该措辞与交付方法示例语境存在疑点，保留来源并等待版本核验。",

      "text_en": "Each of these paces has their place depending on the situation encountered. Using the wrong pace is not just less than good, it often means total failure. Within any one project, high levels of risk may require slower paces of change to ensure that each element has properly managed that risk; while lower levels of risk may enable a solution to be implemented more quickly. Within any change program, different iterations will often need to be addressed at different paces. It is expected that each iteration will be identified as having an appropriate pace and then be organized to deliver at that pace.",

      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Early Agile approaches, such as Scrum, emphasized the delivery of small units of delivery in short sprints at a fast pace. (Note that later Agile approaches, such as SAFe, have broadened this to include larger units of delivery with more content working at different paces.) However, this does not apply in many situations. In large complex situations that are strongly-coupled, stateful, pessimistic, and controlled in nature (such as Nuclear Power Stations, Aircraft Control Systems, or non-repudiation situations) many teams may have to be involved and require significant levels of control and direction. There is a reason why the most important element of a successful large-scale military organization is logistics (organization, consistency, and delivery at scale — potentially in a hub-and-spoke architecture, as in efficient goods delivery) and not commando units (which do have their place and are very effective when used in the right situations, but not at scale).",

section_title: 4.8. 最高层架构中的敏捷性
text:
4.8. 最高层架构中的敏捷性
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:4.8",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0039",
  "section_number": "4.8",
  "title_en": "4.8. Agility at the Highest Levels of Architecture",
  "title_zh": "4.8. 最高层架构中的敏捷性",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    34
  ],
  "translation_zh": "如图 4-5 所示，最高层架构从企业层的架构愿景与战略开始，提供目标状态及周边业务全景的长期视图。愿景与战略的开发可以采用敏捷方式，通过多次迭代，由架构师与业务伙伴协作完成。通常，该层交付的架构是愿景性和概念性的，往往为架构师提供很大灵活性，他们用这一愿景准备更详细的架构。此类高层交付物的发布可能跨越较长时期，而组织敏捷性的一个指标是愿景与战略能够变化的速度。\n\n\n\n\n变革速度还取决于变革的影响。对当前愿景与战略非颠覆性的变革相对快速且容易完成。造成当前战略与愿景巨大转向的变革，应评估其可能对当前已导出或进行中的架构造成多大干扰。此类变革可能产生涓滴效应，因为低层的许多导出架构会受影响。最高层架构变更的频率与数量应低于低层。可行变革量取决于组织对敏捷程度的容忍度。\n\n业务伙伴与架构师持续协作，产出过渡状态架构，并就期望的目标状态达成一致。架构师还应与业务目标对齐，演进架构，使每个过渡状态都提供增量业务价值。\n\n尾注[1]：SAFe/Agile定义取自Agile Alliance术语表，原文列示www.agilealliance.org/agile101/agile-glossary。本轮未读取外部页面。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0034:c000",
      "pdf_page": 34,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "4.8. Agility at the Highest Levels of Architecture",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0034:b001"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        34.434,
        455.544,
        59.22
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G20F:s0039"
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0034:c001",
      "pdf_page": 34,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "As Figure 4-5 shows, the highest level of architecture begins with an architecture vision and strategy at the enterprise level, which provides a long-term view of the target state and surrounding business landscape. The development of the vision and strategy can be done in an Agile style, through multiple iterations as architects collaborate with their business partners. Typically, architecture delivered at this level is visionary and conceptual, and often provides a lot of flexibility to architects who use this vision to prepare more detailed architectures. The release of such high-level deliverables can span a long duration, and an indicator of organizational agility is the speed with which vision and strategy can change.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0034:b002",
        "G20F:p0034:b003",
        "G20F:p0034:b004",
        "G20F:p0034:b005",
        "G20F:p0034:b006",
        "G20F:p0034:b007",
        "G20F:p0034:b008",
        "G20F:p0034:b009"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        68.97,
        563.76,
        193.71
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0034:c002",
      "pdf_page": 34,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The speed of change also depends on the impact of the change. Changes that are non-disruptive to the current vision and strategy are relatively quick and easy to complete. Changes that create a huge pivot in the current strategy and vision should be assessed to see how much disruption they may cause to the currently derived or in-flight architectures. Such changes could have a trickle-down effect as many derived architectures at lower levels are impacted. The frequency and the amount of changes to the architectures at the highest levels should be less than those at the lower levels. How much change is feasible depends on the organization’s tolerance to the amount of agility.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0034:b010",
        "G20F:p0034:b011",
        "G20F:p0034:b012",
        "G20F:p0034:b013",
        "G20F:p0034:b014",
        "G20F:p0034:b015",
        "G20F:p0034:b016"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        207.21,
        563.76,
        316.17
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0034:c003",
      "pdf_page": 34,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Business partners and architects collaborate constantly to produce transition state architectures and align on the aspirational target states. Architects should also align to business goals and evolve the architectures such that every transition state provides an incremental business value.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0034:b017",
        "G20F:p0034:b018",
        "G20F:p0034:b019"
      ],
      "bbox": [

        563.76,
        375.51
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },

    {

text:
5.1. 建立企业架构能力
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:5.1",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0041",
  "section_number": "5.1",
  "title_en": "5.1. Establishing the Enterprise Architecture Capability",
  "title_zh": "5.1. 建立企业架构能力",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    35
  ],
  "translation_zh": "如上一章所述，敏捷企业架构采用迭代、增量方法创建架构制品，需要相应的特定技能与管理方法。ADM 预备阶段的主要目标是建立或调整企业架构能力，以适应将要开展的特定架构工作。敏捷交付中预备阶段的考虑包括：\n\n- 敏捷架构要求更聚焦成果，涉及从项目导向转向产品导向；\n- 多数敏捷工作发生在解决方案空间，而设计思维、业务模型画布等问题空间技术有助于塑造实现解决方案的架构方向；需求常以 JIT 方式出现，需要迭代评估以重申问题定义（ADM 阶段 A）与实现期望解决方案的架构方法（阶段 B、C、D）；\n- 这产生整体化架构方法：较少单独关注架构“域”（业务、数据、应用、技术），更多强调围绕所需产品的跨域协作视图；\n- 这将要求改变企业架构与产品开发的管理与治理方式。\n\n预备阶段包括建立一组**架构原则**（旨在持久、极少修订的通用规则与指南），以指导和支撑组织履行使命的方式。任何风格架构的原则都反映该风格的具体特征。应在该阶段确立“单一产品负责人”原则，确保需求被清晰表达与理解，并在后续阶段排序系统组件的敏捷开发。\n\n《Open Agile Architecture 标准》[C208] 第 5 章“有意架构”提出了敏捷交付中有意架构应遵循的原则。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0035:c002",
      "pdf_page": 35,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "5.1. Establishing the Enterprise Architecture Capability",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0035:b005"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        135.554,
        517.662,
        160.34
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G20F:s0041"
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0035:c003",
      "pdf_page": 35,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "As discussed in the previous chapter, Agile Enterprise Architecture uses an iterative, incremental approach to create architecture artifacts. Specific skills and management approaches must be put in place for this to succeed. The primary objective of the Preliminary Phase of the ADM is to establish or adapt the Enterprise Architecture capability to the specific architecture work to be carried out. Some considerations for the Preliminary Phase in Agile delivery are:",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0035:b006",
        "G20F:p0035:b007",
        "G20F:p0035:b008",
        "G20F:p0035:b009",

      ],

    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0035:c004",
      "pdf_page": 35,
      "content_index_zero_based": 4,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Agile Architecture requires a much closer focus on the outcomes, involving a shift from a project to a product-centricapproach",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0035:b011",
        "G20F:p0035:b012"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        260.99,
        561.01,
        291.05
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0035:c005",
      "pdf_page": 35,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• While most Agile efforts take place in the solution space, techniques that address the problem space, such as design thinking and business model canvassing, help to shape the architecture direction to achieve the solution",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0035:b013",
        "G20F:p0035:b014",
        "G20F:p0035:b015"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        304.55,
        533.206,
        350.39
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0035:c006",
      "pdf_page": 35,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Requirements often come on a JIT basis, requiring iterative evaluation to reaffirm the problem definition (TOGAF ADM Phase A) and the architecture approach to arrive at the desired solution (TOGAF ADM Phases B, C, and D).",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0035:b016",
        "G20F:p0035:b017",
        "G20F:p0035:b018"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        66.24,
        363.89,
        563.76,
        409.73
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0035:c007",
      "pdf_page": 35,
      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• This produces an holistic architecture approach with less individual focus on the “domains” of architecture (Business, Data, Application, and Technology) and more emphasis on collaborative views across all domains focused around the required product",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0035:b019",
        "G20F:p0035:b020",
        "G20F:p0035:b021"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        423.23,
        542.113,
        469.07
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0035:c008",
      "pdf_page": 35,
      "content_index_zero_based": 8,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• This will require changes to the way that Enterprise Architecture and product development is managed and governed",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0035:b022",
        "G20F:p0035:b023"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        56.881,
        476.57,
        533.721,
        506.63
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0035:c009",
      "pdf_page": 35,
      "content_index_zero_based": 9,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The Preliminary Phase includes the establishment of a set of Architecture Principles (general rules and guidelines intended to be enduring and seldom amended) that inform and support the ways in which an organization sets about fulfilling its mission. The Architecture Principles for any style of architecture reflect the specific characteristics of that style. The principle of a single product owner should be established in this phase to ensure that requirements are clearly articulated and understood, and to prioritize the Agile development of the system components in later phases.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0035:b024",
        "G20F:p0035:b025",
        "G20F:p0035:b026",

      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        520.13,

text:
5.2. 产品开发与架构
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:5.2",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0042",
  "section_number": "5.2",
  "title_en": "5.2. Product Development and Architecture",
  "title_zh": "5.2. 产品开发与架构",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    35,
    36
  ],
  "translation_zh": "如图 5-1 所示，传统的、一般化的企业架构视图包含若干阶段。\n\n\n\n\n就 TOGAF ADM 而言：\n\n- 阶段 A 定义问题；\n- 阶段 B、C、D 定义基线与目标；\n- 阶段 E、F、G 部署目标；\n- 阶段 H 管理变更。\n\n在敏捷环境中，这些活动很可能是持续管理的过程，活动并行推进，如图 5-2 所示。\n\n不必在开始其他活动前完成问题定义。只需定义“足够”的问题，为其他活动提供语境。随着其他活动启动，工作可继续细化与扩展问题定义。\n\n显然存在依赖关系。在描述目标某部分的基线与目标被充分定义之前，无法部署该目标的任何部分。\n\n\n\n关于不同架构支持风格的更多实用指导，见《TOGAF 标准——应用 ADM》[C220]。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0035:c011",
      "pdf_page": 35,
      "content_index_zero_based": 11,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "5.2. Product Development and Architecture",
      "source_block_ids": [

      ],
      "bbox": [

      "content_index_zero_based": 12,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "As shown in Figure 5-1, a traditional, generalized view of Enterprise Architecture contains a number of stages.",

  "translation_zh": "> “识别关键利益相关者及其关注点/目标，并定义需要处理的关键业务需求。”\n> ——《TOGAF 标准》\n\n> “阶段 A 所处理的详细程度，取决于与本次架构开发迭代相关的范围子集与目标。”\n> ——《TOGAF 标准》\n\n充分理解企业的战略目标，是任何活动的前提，以确保单项活动不会损害这些目标。\n\n如何在此阶段提高敏捷性：\n\n- 识别产品负责人；\n- 力求快速开发高层战略架构，只包含规划更受约束活动所需的细节；\n- 使用众多可用敏捷工具与技术之一来刻画问题并定义需要处理的具体需求集合，例如：\n  - 业务需求；\n  - 客户旅程；\n  - 设计思维：一种定义问题或寻找新颖创新解决方案的方法（关键特征见表 5-1）；\n  - 史诗（Epics）；\n  - 业务模型画布：一种理解业务基本特征的管理工具；模板见图 5-3。更多细节见《TOGAF® 系列指南：业务模型》[G18A]。\n\n\n\n\n**表 5-1：设计思维**\n\n| 实践 | 思维风格 | 心智 |\n|---|---|---|\n| 以人为本的方法；例如，基于人、以用户为中心、共情、民族志、观察 | 边做边想；例如，早期快速原型、快速学习、快速迭代开发循环 | 发散与收敛方法相结合；例如，构思、发现模式、创建多个备选方案 |\n| 协作式工作风格；例如，多学科协作、让许多利益相关者参与、跨学科团队 | 溯因推理；例如，“可能是什么”的逻辑、发现新机会、创造新事物的冲动、挑战常规 | 反思性重构；例如，重述问题、超越显而易见之处以看清问题背后的东西、挑战既定问题 |\n| 整体观；例如，系统思维、对问题的 360 度视角 | 整合思维；例如，和谐平衡、创造性化解张力、在有效性与可靠性之间取得平衡 | 实验与探索；例如，探索可能性的许可、承担失败风险、快速失败 |\n| 容忍模糊；例如，允许模糊、容忍模糊、对模糊感到自在、流动开放的过程 | 乐观；例如，把约束视为积极因素、乐观态度、享受解决问题 | 面向未来；例如，面向未来、愿景相对于现状、直觉作为驱动力 |\n\n为确保只做“刚好足够”的架构：\n\n- 聚焦所需成果；\n- 定义企业可向客户提供的最小可行产品。\n\n结合业务与技术的新趋势识别新的业务机会，采用由外而内的方法，考虑客户需求与竞争对手活动。\n\n> “敏捷架构应使用营销与设计方法，发现客户可能如何使用产品与服务。待完成工作（Jobs-to-be-done）分析、客户旅程映射与设计思维是敏捷企业使用的方法示例。设计思维是一种以人为本的方法，将人的认知与情感纳入价值定义的关键方面。”\n> ——《The Open Group Open Agile Architecture 标准》公理 2：由外而内思维\n\n价值应从客户立场来规定。应为每个产品或服务族识别从概念到上市、从订单到交付的价值流。企业架构应支持价值流定义，以及满足该需求所需的业务能力。",

text:
5.2.3. 定义目标
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:5.2.3",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0045",
  "section_number": "5.2.3",
  "title_en": "5.2.3. Define Target",
  "title_zh": "5.2.3. 定义目标",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",

    40
  ],
  "translation_zh": "需要定义的范围与详细程度，取决于业务要素对达成目标架构愿景的相关性，以及是否已有架构描述。\n\n如何在此阶段提高敏捷性：\n\n- 在大局语境下渐进式开发目标架构；\n- 聚焦最小可行产品；\n- 按支持后续工作的需要开发细节——只做所需细节（“刚好足够的架构”）；\n- 以企业战略与已排序的待办列表为指导。\n\n同样，关键衡量标准是理解最小可行架构。\n\n一旦描述了问题空间，就必须交付更详细的架构规格，描述所需的业务、数据、应用与技术构建块。这些将成为项目群待办列表的输入项。产品经理与产品负责人是此阶段的关键利益相关者。\n\n如第 4 章所述，必要时可应用分段架构与能力架构概念，把问题分解为更小的部分，以实现更渐进、更迭代的交付。架构的功能与非功能组件被分解为用户故事，构成架构待办列表。用户故事由产品负责人与敏捷团队协商排序。被排序为“必须有”的故事共同构成最小可行架构。\n\n一旦有了一些初始架构规格，它们将定义 SBB 并开始构建冲刺待办列表；即成为有意架构。有意架构是一组有目的、有计划的架构策略与举措，用于增强解决方案设计、性能与可用性，并为团队间设计与实施同步提供指导。",

    {

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "• Focus on the Minimum Viable Product",

      ],
      "bbox": [

    },
    {

      "text_en": "• Develop detail as required to support subsequent work — only the needed detail (“just enough architecture”)",

    {

      "pdf_page": 40,
      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Again, the key measure is understanding the Minimum Viable Architecture.",

      "text_en": "Once the problem space has been described then a more detailed architecture specification has to be delivered to describe the Business, Data, Application, and Technology building blocks needed. These will become the input items for a program backlog. Product managers and product owners are key stakeholders in this stage.",

      "text_en": "As described in Chapter 4, Segment and Capability Architecture concepts can be applied where necessary to decompose the problem into smaller pieces to provide a more progressive and iterative delivery. The functional and non-functional components of the architecture are decomposed into user stories which make up the architecture backlog. User stories are prioritized by the product owner in consultation with the Agile team. Those stories prioritized as “must have” collectively become the Minimum Viable Architecture.",
      "source_block_ids": [

5.2.5. 治理与管理变更
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:5.2.5",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0047",
  "section_number": "5.2.5",
  "title_en": "5.2.5. Govern and Manage Change",
  "title_zh": "5.2.5. 治理与管理变更",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    41
  ],
  "translation_zh": "（变更驱动因素）以往交付项目增量的经验。\n\n治理应嵌入冲刺之中，并成为冲刺回顾与冲刺规划的一部分：\n\n- 为解决方案构建提供指导，使其保持在护栏之内并遵循解决方案跑道；\n  - 护栏可以是技术边界或约束，例如规定要使用的标准组件、性能与容量限制，或技术政策；\n  - 跑道是未来系统构建冲刺将使用的架构定义或技术上层结构；\n- 评估变更对更高层架构的影响；\n- 基于每个冲刺（能力增量）的经验获取反馈，以演进更高层架构。\n\n一旦解决方案实施开始，架构团队应细化用于检验对目标架构符合性的治理指标。这种符合性可由目标与关键结果（OKR）构成，以确保价值正在交付，并确保与标准和法规对齐。\n\n如 O-AA™ 标准 [C208] 所定义，OKR 以具体成就与绩效改进来阐明公司优先级。目标（objectives）由清晰定义的定性变化构成，而关键结果（key results）是必须达成的具体、通常为定量的绩效目标。敏捷组织应每年设定 OKR，并按季度评估进展。\n\n变更是敏捷交付的固有部分，架构治理有助于保持交付团队之间的一致性，以及与更高层架构的一致性。如果变更很大，可能需要转向（pivot），但应在首次高层迭代时进行评估，以确保最终目标与价值交付不丢失，并在必要时调整业务优先级与相互依赖关系。",

text:
5.3. 架构、产品开发与交付
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:5.3",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0048",
  "section_number": "5.3",
  "title_en": "5.3. Architecture, Product Development, and Delivery",
  "title_zh": "5.3. 架构、产品开发与交付",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    42
  ],
  "translation_zh": "在敏捷环境中，以及在已采用敏捷交付方法的支持性组织中，5.2 节所述活动很可能是持续管理、并行处理的过程，更关注成果，以架构作为支持产品交付的载体。\n\n对于敏捷方法，要遵循的阶段相似，但执行方式不同。企业架构迭代支持这种产品定义与产品架构。\n\n问题在战略层与分段层定义，然后在分段层与能力层定义目标，再在能力层由敏捷团队在架构师与能力架构定义的支持下部署目标。\n\n如“架构层级与迭代”所述，在战略层定义高层架构规格——战略主题、史诗，用于指导后续问题定义。在分段层，待办列表与战略定义（问题定义）对齐地定义。该待办列表应进一步细化，产出将使用任何敏捷技术交付的冲刺待办列表。这种敏捷交付由支持敏捷解决方案交付的能力架构支撑。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c000",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 0,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "5.3. Architecture, Product Development, and Delivery",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b001"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        34.434,
        501.57,
        59.22
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G20F:s0048"
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c001",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "In an Agile environment and within supporting organizations that have adopted an Agile delivery approach, it is likely that the activities presented in Section 5.2 will be a continuously managed process handled in parallel and focusing more on the outcome with architecture as the vehicle to support product delivery.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b002",
        "G20F:p0042:b003",
        "G20F:p0042:b004",
        "G20F:p0042:b005"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        68.97,
        563.76,
        130.59
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c002",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "For an Agile approach the stages to follow are similar but performed in a different way. Enterprise Architecture iterations support this product definition and product architecture.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b006",
        "G20F:p0042:b007"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        144.09,
        563.76,
        174.15
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c003",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The problem is defined at the Strategic and Segment level, then at the Segment and Capability level a target is defined, and at the Capability level a target is deployed by Agile teams supported by the architect and the Capability Architecture definition.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b008",
        "G20F:p0042:b009",
        "G20F:p0042:b010"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        187.65,
        563.76,
        233.49
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c004",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 4,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "As explained in Architecture Levels and Iterations, at the Strategic level a high-level architecture specification is defined — strategic themes, epics, that will guide the subsequent problem definition. At the Segment level, the backlog is defined in alignment with the strategic definition (problem definition). This backlog should be refined further to produce the sprint backlog that will be delivered using any Agile technique. This Agile delivery is supported by a Capability Architecture supporting Agile solution delivery.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b011",
        "G20F:p0042:b012",
        "G20F:p0042:b013",
        "G20F:p0042:b014",
        "G20F:p0042:b015",
        "G20F:p0042:b016"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        246.99,
        563.76,
        340.17
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    }
  ],
  "semantic_rules": [
    {
      "kind": "scope-condition-decision",
      "statement_zh": "产品定义贯穿多层架构：战略/分段定义问题，分段/能力定义目标，能力层支持敏捷团队部署；不是三个领域或三个固定部门。",

text:
5.3.1. 识别新需求——定义并识别问题
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:5.3.1",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0049",
  "section_number": "5.3.1",
  "title_en": "5.3.1. Identification of a New Need — Define and Identify the Problem",
  "title_zh": "5.3.1. 识别新需求——定义并识别问题",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    42
  ],
  "translation_zh": "应用企业架构原则与利益相关者评估，辅以设计思维等其他技术，结合业务与技术的新趋势识别新的业务机会，采用由外而内的方法考虑客户需求，并评估竞争对手的做法。\n\n如 O-AA 标准 [C208] 公理 2“由外而内思维”所述，敏捷架构应使用营销与设计方法，发现客户可能如何使用产品与服务。待完成工作分析、客户旅程映射与设计思维是敏捷企业使用的方法示例。设计思维是一种以人为本的方法，将人的认知与情感纳入价值定义的关键方面。\n\n另一个重要考虑是开展业务就绪度评估，以采用可能与新识别业务需求相关的新兴技术，并考虑监管与合规——在定义问题时，遵循标准与公司原则也是关键考虑。\n\n敏捷架构应识别企业价值流。价值应从客户立场来规定。应为每个产品或服务族识别从概念到上市、从订单到交付的价值流。企业架构应支持价值流定义，以及满足该需求所需的业务能力。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c005",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "5.3.1. Identification of a New Need — Define and Identify the Problem",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b017"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        356.589,
        472.43,
        374.49
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G20F:s0049"
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c006",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Apply Enterprise Architecture principles and stakeholder assessment, supported by other techniques like design thinking, to identify new business opportunities considering the new trends in business and technology, taking an outside-in approach to consider customer demands, and assessing what competitors are doing.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b018",
        "G20F:p0042:b019",
        "G20F:p0042:b020",
        "G20F:p0042:b021"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        384.74,
        563.76,
        446.36
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c007",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "As stated in Axiom 2, Outside-In Thinking, in the O-AA Standard [C208], Agile Architecture shall use marketing and design methods to discover how customers are likely to use products and services. Jobs- to-be-done analysis, customer journey mapping, and design thinking are examples of methods used by Agile enterprises. Design thinking, which is a human-centered approach, incorporates human cognition and emotion as key aspects of the value definition.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b022",
        "G20F:p0042:b023",
        "G20F:p0042:b024",
        "G20F:p0042:b025",
        "G20F:p0042:b026"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        459.86,
        563.76,
        537.26
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c008",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 8,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Another important consideration is to perform a business readiness assessment, to adopt a new emerging technology that might be related with the new business need identified, and also to consider regulatory and compliance — adherence to standards and corporative principles is also a key consideration while defining the problem.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b027",
        "G20F:p0042:b028",
        "G20F:p0042:b029",
        "G20F:p0042:b030"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        550.76,
        563.76,
        612.38
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0042:c009",
      "pdf_page": 42,
      "content_index_zero_based": 9,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Agile Architecture should identify the enterprise value streams. Value shall be specified from the standpoint of the customer. A value stream has to be identified for each product or service family from concept to launch and from order to delivery. Enterprise Architecture should support the value stream definition and also the business capabilities needed to fulfill the need.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0042:b031",
        "G20F:p0042:b032",
        "G20F:p0042:b033",
        "G20F:p0042:b034"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        625.88,
        563.76,
        687.5
      ],
      "source_section_id": null
    }
  ],
  "semantic_rules": [
    {
      "kind": "scope-condition-decision",
      "statement_zh": "新兴技术相关业务需要同时审视业务就绪、监管、标准和企业原则；趋势或客户兴趣不能代替采用决策证据。",

          ],
          "quote_en": "business readiness assessment",
          "source_path": "togaf-standard-10th/G20Fe.pdf",
          "source_sha256": "a8fe6569c7d6045ce4ac8d5320c09a3abdc556a0fc1cbcd584bd76a75f3f84be"

      ],
      "id": "G20F:chapter-review:5.3.1:rule01"

  "translation_zh": "一旦描述了问题空间，就必须交付更详细的架构规格，描述所需的业务、数据、应用与技术构建块——该规格将成为产品待办列表定义的输入。产品经理与产品负责人是此过程的关键利益相关者。\n\n为提供敏捷方法，还需要对问题分段。\n\n应应用分段架构与能力架构概念，把问题解耦为更小的部分，使规格以敏捷方式交付。\n\n架构中描绘的特性将有助于确定产品待办列表的优先级，并识别任何相互依赖关系，从而便于定义冲刺待办列表。\n\n架构规格完成后，将提供输入以定义 SBB，并遵循分区概念塑造最终解决方案——该解决方案定义是冲刺待办列表定义的输入，并构成支持敏捷实施的有意架构的基础。\n\n一旦敏捷团队基于架构描述开始交付过程，企业架构团队应细化用于检验符合性的治理指标。这种符合性可通过 OKR 构成，以确保价值正在交付，并确保与标准和监管合规对齐。\n\n治理活动不应孤立进行，因此每当敏捷团队交付一项输出，都应进行回顾，治理过程应成为该冲刺迭代回顾与规划的一部分。\n\n另一方面，变更管理也应在整个过程中持续进行，因为变更可能影响上述任何迭代。因此，应以动态方式识别这些变更，以便快速应用变更，避免过程进一步延误。\n\n如果变更过大或具有颠覆性，则应在首次高层迭代进行分析，以确保最终目标与价值交付不丢失，并能对优先级与相互依赖关系作出适当调整。\n\n敏捷架构应遵循的一个重要概念是有意架构，它规定一组有目的、有计划的架构策略与举措，以增强解决方案设计、性能与可用性，并为团队间设计与实施同步提供指导。\n\n在图 5-4 中，有意架构作为能力架构规格的一部分交付，旨在提供支持实施的护栏。\n\n\n\n\n战略架构的输出为定义产品待办列表提供输入，产品待办列表在分段架构中进一步详细定义。在能力架构层，定义冲刺待办列表，以及将指导实施（部署目标）的有意架构。\n\n变更管理将处理任何新需求与特性，并支持产品待办列表的细化与排序，以便将其分配到不同发布中。\n\n校订注：本版原文PDF44写作“spring backlog”，根据本节多次明确的“sprint backlog”语境译为“冲刺待办列表”；英文来源保持原貌。",

text:
5.4.1. 企业架构的自动化
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:5.4.1",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0053",
  "section_number": "5.4.1",
  "title_en": "5.4.1. Automation of Enterprise Architecture",
  "title_zh": "5.4.1. 企业架构的自动化",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",

    45
  ],
  "translation_zh": "使用企业架构工具可以加速 TOGAF 架构制品的实施。这些工具可以实时收集业务运营数据，并构建/增强架构模型。利用人工智能（AI）算法，它们可以优化模型。这些工具还通过展示采用各种数字技术的影响，支持用户之间的构思与协作。最重要的是，这些工具使企业架构能够量化和度量架构的转型变化。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0045:c005",
      "pdf_page": 45,
      "content_index_zero_based": 5,

      "source_block_ids": [

      ],
      "bbox": [

        347.743,
        319.797,
        365.644

      "source_section_id": "G20F:s0053"

    {
      "id": "G20F:p0045:c006",
      "pdf_page": 45,
      "content_index_zero_based": 6,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The implementation of TOGAF architecture artifacts can be accelerated with the use of Enterprise Architecture tools. These tools can collect business operational data in real-time and build/enhance architecture models. Using Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms, they can optimize the models. The tools also enable ideation and collaboration between the users by showing the impact of adopting various digital technologies. Most importantly, these tools enable the Enterprise Architecture to quantify and measure transformation changes to the architecture.",

        "G20F:p0045:b009",

5.4.2. 最小化制品
{
  "id": "G20F:chapter-review:5.4.2",
  "source_section_id": "G20F:s0054",
  "section_number": "5.4.2",
  "title_en": "5.4.2. Minimalistic Artifacts",
  "title_zh": "5.4.2. 最小化制品",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",

    45
  ],
  "translation_zh": "制品及其模板应包含与其目的相一致的最小内容，不多不少。本文档前几节所述的渐进式、迭代式架构开发，可通过使用一系列详细程度和/或范围递增的模板来产出制品来实现。例如，阶段 B（业务架构）的第一个制品可能只包含基线架构；对于大型项目，还可进一步分为一个概览制品，随后是一系列描述更详细的制品。",
  "source_units": [
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0045:c007",
      "pdf_page": 45,
      "content_index_zero_based": 7,
      "type": "heading",
      "text_en": "5.4.2. Minimalistic Artifacts",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G20F:p0045:b015"
      ],
      "bbox": [
        48.24,
        485.493,
        215.394,
        503.394
      ],
      "source_section_id": "G20F:s0054"
    },
    {
      "id": "G20F:p0045:c008",
      "pdf_page": 45,
      "content_index_zero_based": 8,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Artifacts and their templates should contain the minimum content that is consistent with their purpose, and no more. The progressive, iterative development of architecture described in previous sections of this document can be realized by producing the artifacts using a series of templates of increasing detail and/or scope. For example, a first artifact from Phase B, Business Architecture, might contain just the Baseline Architecture, or for large projects, this could be further divided into an overview artifact followed by a series of artifacts with more detailed descriptions.",

  "translation_zh": "- **预备阶段**\n  - 定义企业架构组织能力与成熟度模型，以支持优化的业务、数据、应用与技术架构，尤其是当它们响应市场颠覆性趋势时；例如，通过新价值主张使组织演进为数字产品供给，以及为其交付进行客户旅程映射\n  - 定义企业架构原则与治理框架，以支持架构愿景\n  - 定义组织层面所需的变更，以调整组织能力与结构，从而实施业务价值，并以高效、有效的方式支持开发与部署；例如，在必要时调整以满足应用/系统/组合交付的敏捷方法\n\n    可能需要新的组织结构模型，这意味着新角色、技能与能力，以及一个跨组织单元、旨在建立自主自赋能敏捷团队的新组织模型。这将使组织能够扩展其敏捷开发。\n\n  - 所需制品：\n    - 组织映射；见《TOGAF® 系列指南：组织映射》[G206]\n    - 如何建立企业架构能力；见《TOGAF® 系列指南：TOGAF® 领导者建立与演进 EA 能力指南》[G184]\n  - 组织原则——审查并在需要时调整\n- **阶段 A：架构愿景**\n  - 定义与组织战略和使命一致的业务价值主张与战略\n  - 如果需要重新定义整个公司战略以满足新趋势，则需在架构愿景阶段处理\n  - 所需制品：\n    - 战略与动机模型，描绘产品战略以支持能力层决策\n  - 额外支持：\n    - 如何调整 ADM 以支持战略架构与决策；见《TOGAF® 系列指南：遵循 TOGAF® ADM 开发企业架构的实践者方法》[G186]\n    - 价值流与业务能力建模、业务模型指南，用于产品的高层模型；见《TOGAF® 系列指南集：业务架构》[T190]\n  - 在此阶段，非常重要的是把企业架构设想为模块化的，使其交付与支持更高效、更易于变更\n- **阶段 B：业务架构**\n  - 用于定义旨在解决问题空间、构建解决方案空间的关键特性与收益\n  - 需求定义并转化为功能与非功能需求——并为每个产品定义目标市场、特性与价值主张\n  - 设计交付产品所需的价值流与业务能力\n  - 所需制品：\n    - 价值流、业务能力，与组织映射关联，信息映射以识别所需关键信息——BMC 等业务模型以及业务运营模型\n  - 为不同受众建模客户旅程；见《TOGAF® 系列指南集：业务架构》[T190]\n- **阶段 C：信息系统架构**\n  - 交付产品特性并处理相关客户细分所需的信息——在产品的不同交付阶段构建与支持产品所需的信息，以及向目标受众与客户营销和销售产品所需的信息：客户画像\n  - 用所需信息与所需数据分析细化客户旅程图\n- **阶段 C：应用架构**\n  - 将产品功能特性与产品推向市场所需的能力进行映射\n  - 所需制品：\n    - 将功能映射到应用组件与服务\n  - 应用基于微服务和松耦合组件的架构模式，使其更易于开发、交付与维护，并具有清晰的集成点；其关键在于追求有效的集成与交付\n- **阶段 D：技术架构**\n  - 支持产品开发、交付与维护的技术或技术平台——方法取决于产品类型：如果是应用或软件系统，则是支持应用组件与服务的技术平台；如果是基于云的服务，则应调整方法以满足该需求",

  "translation_zh": "The Open Group是一个全球性联盟，通过技术标准和开源倡议帮助实现业务目标，并在900多家多元成员中培育合作、包容和相互尊重的文化。成员涵盖多个行业的客户、系统与解决方案供应商、工具厂商、集成商、学术人员及咨询人员。\n\nThe Open Group的使命是推动实现无边界信息流（Boundaryless Information Flow™），实现方式包括：与客户合作，捕获、理解并满足当前及新兴需求，制定政策和共享最佳实践；与供应商、联盟及标准组织合作，形成共识、促进互操作性，并演进和集成规范及开源技术；提供全面服务，提升联盟运营效率；开发并运营业界领先的认证服务，鼓励采购认证产品。\n\n进一步信息见原文列示 www.opengroup.org。The Open Group出版广泛技术文档，多数着重标准与指南，也包括白皮书、技术研究、认证及测试文档和商业著作，完整详情及目录见 www.opengroup.org/library。",

  "translation_zh": "TOGAF®系列指南说明如何使用TOGAF标准，以及如何裁剪它以满足特定需求。\n\n系列指南预计是TOGAF标准发展最快的部分，其定位是标准中的指导部分。TOGAF基础内容预期长期稳定，而使用指导可针对特定行业、架构风格、目的或问题。例如，扩展企业转型所需的利益相关者、关注点、视图及支撑模型，可能与内部IT环境迁移到云所需内容大不相同；两者都使用ADM，从架构愿景出发，发展目标架构并形成实施与迁移计划。TOGAF基础内容仍是跨行业、领域和风格的必要基础。",

      "text_en": "The TOGAF® Series Guides contain guidance on how to use the TOGAF Standard and how to adapt it to fulfill specific needs.",

      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "The TOGAF® Series Guides are expected to be the most rapidly developing part of the TOGAF Standard and are positioned as the guidance part of the standard. While the TOGAF Fundamental Content is expected to be long-lived and stable, guidance on the use of the TOGAF Standard can be industry, architectural style, purpose, and problem-specific. For example, the stakeholders, concerns, views, and supporting models required to support the transformation of an extended enterprise may be significantly different than those used to support the transition of an in-house IT environment to the cloud; both will use the Architecture Development Method (ADM), start with an Architecture Vision, and develop a Target Architecture on the way to an Implementation and Migration Plan.   "translation_zh": "（以下所属机构为文档批准时的信息。）\n\n**Serge Bouwens，ArchiXL**\n\nSerge Bouwens 多年来在多家咨询机构担任敏捷实践者与架构顾问。他一直在荷兰工作，帮助客户组织将其架构实践提升到更高水平。作为实践者，他在架构领域积累了丰富经验，涵盖从企业架构到解决方案架构、从传统方法到敏捷方法。他为 cibit academy 开发了企业架构与敏捷架构的大师课程。Serge 参与编写本文档的动力，源于他坚信架构职业需要一套扎实的标准，而 The Open Group TOGAF 标准应当拥抱敏捷，以保持其领先标准地位。\n\n**Mats Gejnevall，Biner Consulting**\n\nMats Gejnevall 是 The Open Group 的长期成员，参与过许多不同的架构标准与指南。自 2006 年起，他一直担任 The Open Group SOA 工作组（SOA Work Group）的联合主席。Mats 目前担任导师与架构师，帮助各组织建立企业架构能力，制定架构与路线图，推动企业转型为适应性未来状态。他的工作遍及各类行业，从政府到产业界，从电信到国防。\n\n**Mirosław Prywata，Asseco Data Systems SA**\n\nMirosław Prywata（www.linkedin.com/in/miroslawprywata）是 Asseco Data Systems 的企业架构与项目管理专家。他作为架构师和首席架构师参与了多个转型项目，帮助组织完成变革。他还是项目管理方法论（敏捷与传统方法）方面的专家和认证培训师。\n\n**Łukasz Wrześniewski，ALVRO SARL**\n\nŁukasz Wrześniewski（www.linkedin.com/in/lukaszwrzesniewski）担任敏捷转型与企业架构顾问。他专长于敏捷企业架构与敏捷项目群管理。他还是一位活跃的培训师，提供 TOGAF®、ArchiMate®、IT4IT™ 与 Scaled Agile 培训课程。他参与 The Open Group 架构论坛敏捷架构工作流（Agile Architecture Work Stream），以及 TOGAF、IT4IT、ArchiMate 协调项目（Harmonization Project）。",

  "translation_zh": "本文档旨在说明如何用冲刺来：\n\n- 以敏捷方式协作应用企业架构与 TOGAF® 架构开发方法（ADM）；\n- 创建适合与敏捷实践配合使用的企业架构；\n- 针对特定业务需求支持敏捷团队并与之协作；\n- 使企业架构师能够借助敏捷实践，确保解决方案的敏捷交付与战略目标一致，并考虑现有架构全景。\n\n本文档说明如何在各种敏捷状态下与解决方案的所有利益相关者进行**情境化接触**的模式。在创造优秀解决方案时，我们把系统思维的分析与综合，同设计思维的创新与直觉结合起来，让利益相关者（内部与外部客户、业务、企业架构与解决方案团队）共同成为设计者。这有时被称为“第三代设计”[Pourdehnad et al.]。\n\n本文档展示企业架构与敏捷解决方案开发之间使用 TOGAF ADM 的若干协作模式。这些模式并非唯一可行，只是最可能被使用的样例；与任何模式一样，应依据组织使用敏捷实践的方式加以调整。无论你刚踏上敏捷之旅还是已走得很远，都应能从这些模式及建议的 ADM 调整方式中获得启发。\n\n本文档展示四种协作模式如何把冲刺应用于企业架构工作：\n\n- 企业架构开发敏捷；\n- 解决方案协作；\n- 跨开发协作；\n- 跨职能敏捷。\n\n本文档从企业架构师与参与敏捷转型的其他团队成员互动的视角撰写。敏捷团队成员借助基于 The Open Group TOGAF 标准的企业架构同样有价值，因此这些视角也可在此推知。\n\n本文档聚焦于用冲刺以敏捷方式交付企业架构交付物，不涉及将任何完整的冲刺框架映射到 TOGAF ADM。\n\n本文档假设读者熟悉冲刺并理解时间盒（time-boxing）活动的目的[1]。敏捷团队协作必须贯穿接触的完整生命周期：从早期愿景、架构设计、跨迭代解决方案交付直至维护。目标是理解利益相关者在短期、中期与长期希望获得的成果，以及这将如何随时间影响业务、企业架构与解决方案。\n\nTOGAF 标准允许用户以迭代方式使用 ADM。ADM 可按不同迭代方法增量交付价值。迭代概念深植于 TOGAF ADM 之中。正如《TOGAF 标准——应用 ADM（对 ADM 应用迭代）》所述：\n\n> “ADM 支持若干以迭代为特征的概念。”\n\n本文档是对 TOGAF 标准调整的一个通用示例，其描述方式可为读者自己的情境化解决方案开发或企业适配提供启发。\n\n敏捷、DevOps、DevSecOps 与持续集成/持续部署（CI/CD）是四种不同的实践，各自都很重要。当开发组织按各自目的同时使用这四者时，结果具有变革性。\n\n本文档聚焦架构师如何使用敏捷冲刺过程概念，与敏捷团队其他成员协作并增值的模式。这些企业架构工作与决策可能发生在技术特定决策之前，或与之并发，取决于团队职责内的构成与成果。\n\n**尾注**\n\n[1] 参见 en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeboxing。",

  "translation_zh": "- **敏捷**（Agile）：快速、轻松地移动/变化，通常为提供能产生价值的成果。\n- **待办列表**（Backlog）：由利益相关者排序、不断演进的需求列表，告知敏捷团队先处理哪些需求。业务变革设计与开发通常使用顶层待办列表，称为**业务变革待办列表**；每个参与冲刺的敏捷团队通常为每个冲刺创建待办列表，称为**冲刺待办列表**。\n- **业务开发**（Business Development）：关于潜在增长或效率机会的分析性准备，以及对这些机会实施的支持与监控的任务与过程，但不包括战略决策与机会实施决策。\n- **业务利益相关者**：可以是产品客户、生态伙伴、内部业务用户等。TOGAF 的定义是“对系统拥有利益的个人、团队、组织或其类别”。\n- **持续部署**（CD）：通过自动化部署频繁交付软件功能的软件工程方法。\n- **持续集成**（CI）：每天多次把所有开发人员的工作副本合并到共享主干的实践。\n- **演示**（Demo）：冲刺结束时举行的会议，冲刺团队展示冲刺成果，并向利益相关者与其他冲刺团队征求反馈。\n- **DevOps**：旨在改善客户价值流的组织文化，聚焦 CALMS（文化、自动化、精益、度量与分享）/ITIL V4。\n- **DevSecOps**：一种“人人对安全负责”的思维方式，目标是在不牺牲必要安全性的前提下，把安全决策以速度与规模分发给掌握最高上下文的人。\n- **DORP**：每个冲刺团队在冲刺结束时开展的四项活动——演示所做工作、成果管理、对冲刺绩效的回顾分析、下一冲刺规划。\n- **最小可行架构**（MVA）：可实现的、能增加业务价值的最小（企业）架构。\n- **最小可行业务开发**（MVBD）：为利益相关者交付显著价值的最小业务变革集合。\n- **最小可行产品**（MVP）：满足最小功能与非功能需求、可在实际运营环境中实现的产出。\n- **产品**（Product）：企业生成并提供给客户的成果，包括物料和/或服务。\n- **回顾**（Retrospective）：冲刺结束时举行的时间盒会议，冲刺团队检视其过程，确定哪些成功、哪些可改进。回顾是敏捷团队“检视并适应”、追求“持续改进”的关键。\n- **解决方案**（Solution）：交付给客户（企业内部或外部）的产品、服务或系统。\n- **冲刺**（Sprint）：敏捷团队为完成一定工作量、支持交付可运行解决方案而工作的短时间盒周期。冲刺是敏捷方法论的核心。\n- **速率**（Velocity）：敏捷团队完成工作的速率。它并非用于直接衡量进度，而是用于准确估算团队未来冲刺的容量并指导冲刺规划。\n- **VUCA**：1987 年首次使用的缩略语，描述或反映总体条件与情境的易变性（Volatility）、不确定性（Uncertainty）、复杂性（Complexity）与模糊性（Ambiguity）。\n\n尾注：[1]持续部署，原文列示https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Continuous_deployment；[2]持续集成，原文列示https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Continuous_integration。本轮未读取外部页面。\n\n校订注：本指南第2章的Solution定义面向内外部客户，第3.2节又说明解决方案不一定提供给客户；保留局部语境差异，不强行合并为无条件统一定义。Business Development定义中对“decisions on strategy and implementation”的排除边界应按本组织职责再确认，本定义不自行授予业务开发团队战略或实施批准权。",

  "translation_zh": "冲刺能够且应当与 TOGAF 标准配合使用，原因有多方面：\n\n- 竞争速度要求解决方案或产品更快交付；\n- 工作方式与技术的创新使之成为可能且必要；\n- 架构师必须准备好以企业应对内外部环境变化（VUCA）所需的速度快速反应；\n- 功能交付与上市时间应尽可能短；\n- 以瀑布方式交付单体企业架构、流程与应用，是 1980 年代已确立并被认识到的反模式；这并非 TOGAF 框架所倡导、推荐或固有的做法（参见《TOGAF® 系列指南：使用 TOGAF® 框架定义并治理面向服务的架构》[G174]）；\n- 成功的组织会（在适当情况下）部署更松耦合的架构，由多个独立构建块组成，接口已知，并由小型团队及时、快速地交付；参见《TOGAF 标准——应用 ADM（架构分区）》[C220] 与《TOGAF® 系列指南：使用 TOGAF® 框架定义并治理面向服务的架构》[G174]；\n- 由微服务架构（MSA）实现的、超越面向服务架构（SOA）的功能与粒度进一步分解与解耦，已成为常见实践 [W196]；\n- 短周期工作（冲刺）是应对不可预测性与风险（例如信息迟到）的一种方式；\n- 在迭代方法（敏捷/TOGAF 框架）中，我们基于当时所知以及实验的真实结果进行实验并做出决策（经验方法）；\n- 尽早测试概念，避免在工作开始前编造细节与潜在场景；\n- 随着业务环境对客户需求变化的适应性增强，TOGAF 框架与敏捷所提供的迭代方法对于快速、高效地响应至关重要。\n\n以迭代方式开发企业架构、作为应用 TOGAF ADM 的一种方法，长期以来一直是《TOGAF 标准——应用 ADM（对 ADM 应用迭代）》[C220] 的一部分。使用冲刺等迭代更短的敏捷实践开展迭代开发，同样是获取早期利益相关者反馈与成果的有用工具。\n\n敏捷迭代实践使企业架构师能够以规划式或涌现式的方式，更早、更迭代地交付价值。\n\n把工作划分为冲刺，不仅意味着把工作切成小块，还意味着在短周期内边做边学，并基于冲刺评审与冲刺回顾（工作方式）进行调整。\n\n这些周期应当短，以便快速响应业务需求定义过程中出现的一切。适应（adapting）有两层含义：\n\n- 让解决方案适应不断变化的需求与优先级；\n- 基于冲刺期间的经验，调整应用 ADM 交付解决方案的方式。\n\n冲刺中的需求被分解为更小、更易管理的增量需求，从而实现透明性并便于变更。",

3.3. 如何在 TOGAF ADM 中冲刺
{

  "title_zh": "3.3. 如何在 TOGAF ADM 中冲刺",

  "translation_zh": "在企业架构开发中使用冲刺有多种方式。\n\n企业架构可用于多种变革的定义，例如业务转型、支持并购与剥离、生态协作。本文档统称为“**业务变革**”。\n\n为业务变革细化并开发解决方案，可能涉及不同类型的敏捷能力：\n\n- 敏捷业务能力：例如来自内部业务开发人员、业务用户、客户或生态业务开发者；\n- 敏捷企业架构能力与专长：通常包括业务、数据/信息、应用、技术与安全相关角色；\n- 敏捷解决方案开发能力：例如业务流程开发人员、解决方案架构师与 IT 解决方案开发人员。\n\n架构师、业务与解决方案开发之间的协作方式很多。本文档把更敏捷的企业架构工作路线划分为四种可应用的方法（图 3-1），取决于组织敏捷实践的需要；这些协作层级往往与企业敏捷成熟度相一致。\n\n\n\n四种协作方式如下：\n\n- **企业架构开发敏捷**：用冲刺交付业务变革所需的企业架构。把交付企业架构所需的 ADM 阶段（A 至 F）划分为一组冲刺，通常每个冲刺包含 ADM（A–F）的一个切片（分区）。治理遵循 TOGAF 治理框架，也可调整为敏捷方式。\n- **解决方案协作**：由企业架构与敏捷解决方案团队协作冲刺交付解决方案。每个冲刺同时包含企业架构与敏捷解决方案开发；企业架构团队为后续开发冲刺创建 MVA。\n- **跨开发协作**：由敏捷业务开发、敏捷企业架构与敏捷解决方案开发协作冲刺交付解决方案。每个冲刺包含三者；业务开发团队为后续企业架构冲刺创建 MVBD，企业架构团队为后续开发冲刺创建 MVA。交付企业架构有多种语境，每种语境下对冲刺、成果与成员的解释会有所不同（详见第 5 章）。\n- **跨职能敏捷**：由混合的跨职能冲刺团队交付解决方案，所有团队都包含敏捷业务开发、敏捷企业架构与敏捷解决方案开发能力。每个冲刺团队都具备三种能力，以打破孤岛、确保一致的创新；这些能力在同一团队内协作。",

{

  "translation_zh": "每个冲刺结束时，冲刺团队开展四项活动：\n\n1. 演示所做工作；\n2. 成果管理；\n3. 对冲刺绩效的回顾分析；\n4. 下一冲刺规划。\n\n演示向利益相关者与其他冲刺团队展示已完成冲刺的成果，目的在于：\n\n- 确保所有利益相关者理解他们将获得什么；\n- 评审冲刺结果，确保增量满足业务与质量目标；\n- 了解其他团队取得了什么成果；\n- 视情况向客户交付 MVP。\n\n成果（价值）可以是企业架构、模型、设计、流程、MVP、运行中的软件等的呈现，取决于冲刺团队当时工作的成熟度。重点应更多放在展示可测试的解决方案上，即使是原型级别。展示架构可以，但重点应更多放在解决方案本身。\n\n成果按类型以不同方式使用：业务开发成果（如 MVBD）进入企业架构团队的待办列表；企业架构成果（如 MVA）进入解决方案开发团队的待办列表；解决方案开发成果可通过 DevOps 过程进入生产。\n\n每次回顾时，冲刺团队评估上一冲刺工作方式的绩效并做出必要调整。冲刺回顾是冲刺团队持续改进的关键方面，目标是逐冲刺提升团队速率，在最短时间内交付最大业务价值。\n\n每次冲刺规划时，使用业务变革待办列表，基于所选排序策略选择下一冲刺的工作。每个冲刺都应有**冲刺目标**，它是强制性的，也是规划过程的入口。冲刺目标是冲刺成功必须达成的事项。来自业务变革待办列表的需求，连同已部署解决方案的利益相关者反馈，被拆分为更小需求，并按实现冲刺目标的方式排序。企业架构工作中的冲刺目标可以是企业架构中明确定义的部分，或架构全景中考虑特定业务方面的部分。企业架构成果应在冲刺结束时可以演示，并应与业务变革和业务价值交付相关。\n\n来自业务利益相关者或冲刺团队的**业务需求与解决方案变更**将加入业务变革与冲刺待办列表并被评估；若影响总体愿景，需快速处理。每个冲刺待办列表定义结束时进行细化，重新排序需求，作为下一冲刺规划的基础。\n\n每个冲刺都是时间盒。若计划工作未在冲刺结束前完成，将放入业务变革待办列表，在下一冲刺规划中处理。",

"text_en": "The outcomes (values) can be a presentation of the Enterprise Architecture, models, designs, processes, an MVP, running software, etc. depending on the maturity level of the work being done by the sprint team at that time. The focus should be more on showing a testable solution, even if it is at prototype level. It is fine to present the architecture, but the focus should be more on the solution itself.",

      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 1,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Depending on the type of the outcome, it will be used in different ways. The business development outcome (e.g., an MVBD) becomes part of the backlog for the Enterprise Architecture team; an Enterprise Architecture outcome (e.g., an MVA) becomes part of the backlog for the solution development teams. Solution development outcomes can be moved into production using a DevOps process.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G210:p0021:b005",
        "G210:p0021:b006",
        "G210:p0021:b007",

      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 2,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "At each retrospective, the sprint teams will evaluate the performance of their way of working during the last sprint and make necessary adjustments. Sprint retrospectives are a crucial aspect of the continuous improvement of the sprint teams. The goal is to improve team velocity from sprint to sprint, and to deliver the most business value in the shortest possible time.",
      "source_block_ids": [
        "G210:p0021:b010",
        "G210:p0021:b011",

    },
    {
      "id": "G210:p0021:c003",
      "pdf_page": 21,
      "content_index_zero_based": 3,
      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "At each planning step of the sprint, the business change backlog is used to select the work for the next sprint based on the prioritization strategy selected. For each sprint there should be a sprint goal, which is obligatory and is the entry for the planning process. The sprint goal is something that is required to be achieved for a successful sprint. Requirements from the business change backlog together with feedback from stakeholders from previously deployed solutions are split into smaller requirements and prioritized in such a way as to achieve the sprint goal. The sprint goal in Enterprise Architecture work may be, for example, clearly defined parts of the Enterprise Architecture or a part of the architecture landscape that takes into account specified business aspects of the Enterprise Architecture. The outcome of the Enterprise Architecture should be demonstrable at the end of the sprint and should be related to business change and business value delivery.",

        "G210:p0021:b014",
        "G210:p0021:b015",
        "G210:p0021:b016",
        "G210:p0021:b017",
        "G210:p0021:b018",

      "type": "text",
      "text_en": "Changes to the business needs and solutions received from business stakeholders or sprint teams will be added to the business change and sprint backlogs and are evaluated. If they affect the overall vision, they need to be addressed quickly. At the end of each sprint backlog definition, refinement is done to reprioritize requirements. This becomes the basis for sprint planning in the next sprint.",

  "translation_zh": "将使用两类待办列表：\n\n- **业务变革待办列表**：包含整个业务变革的需求，基于企业架构愿景、目标与战略；\n- **冲刺待办列表**：包含下一冲刺的需求；每个冲刺团队一个，基于业务变革待办列表及企业架构愿景、目标与战略。\n\n企业架构师支持冲刺规划，提供不同冲刺之间的互操作性与依赖信息——这对估算交付所需工作量很重要，也支持优先级定义。",

text:
3.3.4. 第一个冲刺（冲刺零或战略冲刺）
{
  "id": "G210:chapter-review:3.3.4",
  "source_section_id": "G210:s0022",
  "section_number": "3.3.4",
  "title_en": "3.3.4. First Sprint (Sprint Zero or Strategic Sprint)",
  "title_zh": "3.3.4. 第一个冲刺（冲刺零或战略冲刺）",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    22,
    23
  ],
  "translation_zh": "框架中的冲刺通常不区分类型。然而在企业架构语境中，建议以准备冲刺开始。由于我们使用冲刺进行企业架构开发，也建议把这个引入阶段组织为独立冲刺，通常称为“**冲刺零**”或“**战略冲刺**”。它符合“前期足够设计”（EDUF）方法，是准备未来工作基础的时段，也契合“有意架构”（intentional architecture）概念。\n\n视语境而定，它可以是初始业务需求、主要能力、价值流与业务转型的高层路线图，帮助排序未来冲刺的内容。该冲刺的输入是业务改进与 IT 改进需求，以及现有战略与分段架构。\n\n业务需求、价值流、能力、路线图与利益相关者需求用于建立业务变革待办列表，安排后续企业架构冲刺的工作。业务变革待办列表中的企业架构部分可包括：\n\n- 要做出的主要（企业架构/设计）选择；\n- 为这些选择提供恰当框架必须做的工作（问题—选项—论证）；\n- 最具价值生成能力的利益相关者需求。\n\n许多决策可在后续冲刺待办列表中拆分为更小部分。\n\n> 注意：“冲刺零”概念并非被所有敏捷实践者接受。\n\n识别无悔（no-regret）决策（即在所有情景下都行之有效的决策）可以争取一些时间。后续冲刺将选取最具价值生成性的业务变革待办事项，并创建业务变革的下一个版本。可采用多种策略对业务变革待办列表与冲刺待办列表排序：\n\n- 利用企业架构及其他工作范围内的价值流；最具价值生成性的部分先创建；\n- 业务变革中风险最高的部分先创建；\n- 使用贯穿所有相关 ADM 阶段的重要切片（分区），确保各部分协同工作；\n- 企业架构及其他工作中易于定义和实施的部分先创建。\n\n“最具价值生成性”可能是团队为继续推进而需要做出的第一个决策。\n\n后续冲刺将选取最具价值生成性的业务变革待办事项，并创建解决方案的下一个版本。\n\n冲刺零结束时，像任何其他冲刺一样开展 DORP。只详细规划下一冲刺；不预先规划其他冲刺。",

text:
3.3.5. 企业架构开发敏捷
{
  "id": "G210:chapter-review:3.3.5",
  "source_section_id": "G210:s0023",
  "section_number": "3.3.5",
  "title_en": "3.3.5. Enterprise Architecture Development Agility",
  "title_zh": "3.3.5. 企业架构开发敏捷",
  "status": "source-compared-revised",
  "translation_mode": "revised-existing-translation",
  "pdf_pages": [
    23,
    24
  ],
  "translation_zh": "冲刺可用于创建企业架构交付物。方法是用企业架构冲刺以敏捷方式交付企业架构。\n\n用冲刺开展企业架构可产生以下积极效果：\n\n- 确保企业架构团队在回顾中改进工作过程；\n- 确保企业架构团队通过利益相关者反馈理解关注点；\n- 在业务变革/冲刺待办列表与冲刺规划中有效处理变更；\n- 由于冲刺规模与架构工作速率，能更好地估算整个企业架构工作；\n- 由于早期利益相关者反馈，更容易提早终止项目。\n\n第一个冲刺（冲刺零）如前所述。其成果随后像其他冲刺一样处理；每个冲刺交付一个 MVA。\n\n每次演示时，企业架构冲刺团队演示所创建的企业架构，确保利益相关者（客户）理解他们将获得什么。\n\n每次回顾时，企业架构冲刺团队评估所交付企业架构描述的质量及上一冲刺架构过程的绩效，并做出必要调整；可通过需求分配方式与团队对工作量的估算来度量团队速率。\n\n规划每个冲刺时，企业架构冲刺团队使用业务变革待办列表，为下一冲刺待办列表选择最具价值（最重要）的事项，包括潜在变更。必要时，可多个企业架构冲刺团队并行工作。\n\n完成企业架构的一系列冲刺后，可开始企业架构的实施。视方法而定，可能可以并行：若企业架构定义足够清晰，部分解决方案团队可开始实施；或可开发不依赖其他部分的解决方案（这体现了遵循解耦设计策略的重要性）。实施由企业架构团队与业务支持并治理。\n\n\n\n解决方案可用敏捷或任何其他方法完成，治理方式应适配实施方法，取决于组织成熟度。图 3-2 展示企业架构工作如何划分为冲刺。采用此协作模式时，整个企业架构在实施开始前创建，但企业架构团队应考虑企业架构范围与深度同实施方法的关系。\n\n示例：企业架构团队在每个冲刺中为业务变革定义架构切片（分区）。切片可包含 ADM 阶段 A 至 F 的相关内容；每个切片可直接实施，或在完整企业架构完成后实施。",

3.3.6. 解决方案协作
{
  "id": "G210:chapter-review:3.3.6",

  "translation_zh": "在解决方案协作中，解决方案团队的解决方案架构师最好积极参与冲刺企业架构的创建过程，企业架构师也积极参与支持解决方案团队。\n\n企业架构团队为即将到来的冲刺创建**恰好及时**的 MVA，敏捷解决方案开发团队为该 MVA 创建解决方案。两个团队在演示中尽早获得业务变革利益相关者的反馈。\n\n敏捷解决方案不限于软件；也可以是创建/更新的业务流程、营销活动、新的/更新的物理 XML 模型或技术更新。\n\n这会带来额外的积极效果：\n\n- 业务变革利益相关者更早理解将从冲刺演示中获得什么；\n- 参与创建与实施企业架构的敏捷解决方案团队确保更好的架构；\n- 敏捷解决方案团队的决策与关注点快速反馈给架构师；\n- 参与企业架构创建与实施的敏捷解决方案团队确保增强的业务价值；\n- 敏捷解决方案团队快速理解企业架构决策的影响并能反馈；\n- 业务变革提案与企业架构可在流程更早阶段、对解决方案影响有更好理解的情况下重做。\n\n如图 3-3 所示，第一个冲刺（冲刺零）的结果与仅用冲刺做企业架构时相同。\n\n业务需求、路线图、利益相关者需求与冲刺零的结果，用于建立业务变革待办列表，安排后续业务与企业架构冲刺的工作。\n\n下一冲刺将基于所选排序策略，为敏捷解决方案开发与敏捷企业架构团队挑选最具价值生成的待办事项。据此，企业架构团队根据上一冲刺的业务开发（MVBD）需求，定义未来冲刺的架构，为后续冲刺交付 MVA，并交付可投入运营的解决方案。\n\n每次演示时，解决方案与企业架构冲刺团队演示已完成的业务变革增量与所创建的企业架构（MVA），确保利益相关者理解将获得什么及所交付的客户/业务价值。\n\n每次回顾时，两个团队评估上一冲刺绩效并做出必要调整。\n\n规划每个冲刺时，两团队使用业务变革待办列表，基于所选排序策略为下一冲刺选择需求。\n\n冲刺期间，企业架构团队支持解决方案团队理解企业架构（上一 MVA），解决方案团队则对下一冲刺拟议的企业架构（MVA）给出反馈。\n\n\n\n虚线表示协作与敏捷治理和支持。示例：企业架构团队在每个冲刺中为业务变革定义架构切片，解决方案团队为这些切片开发解决方案。",

3.3.7. 跨开发协作

  "translation_zh": "业务开发也应以敏捷方式进行。该协作模式定义敏捷业务开发、企业架构与敏捷解决方案团队如何在解决方案创建过程中积极协作（图 3-4）。\n\n这会带来额外的积极效果：\n\n- 业务开发参与业务变革的创建；\n- 业务开发快速理解业务决策的影响；\n- 业务开发决策从整体视角被评估；\n- 业务开发提案可在对影响有更好理解的情况下重做；\n- 架构师与解决方案团队更好地理解业务需求；\n- 架构师能够影响业务决策、需求与开发；\n- 解决方案团队能够影响业务决策、需求与开发。\n\n第一个冲刺（冲刺零）将创建业务变革的初始愿景，帮助在业务开发、企业架构与敏捷解决方案团队协作下排序未来冲刺内容。\n\n每次演示时，每个敏捷团队演示当前解决方案增量、拟议的业务开发（MVBD）与未来冲刺的企业架构（MVA）。MVBD 与 MVA 的创建确保所有利益相关者理解将获得什么、以及如何影响结果。潜在客户可开始使用产品增量。\n\n每次回顾时，所有团队评估上一冲刺过程绩效并做出必要调整。\n\n规划每个冲刺时，所有团队使用业务变革待办列表，为下一冲刺选择最具价值（最重要）的需求。\n\n在此成熟度水平，业务开发团队为下一企业架构冲刺增强业务变革，架构团队为下一解决方案冲刺产出恰好及时的企业架构；业务开发与企业架构团队也随时支持解决方案团队，解决方案团队则对下一冲刺的业务与企业架构交付物给出反馈。\n\n\n\n虚线表示协作与敏捷治理和支持。\n\n例如，业务团队在冲刺 1 中开展 MVBD 工作，企业架构团队在冲刺 2 中为该 MVBD 定义恰好及时的企业架构（MVA），解决方案团队在冲刺 3 中为该 MVA 创建解决方案。\n\nMVBD 可以是一组增量式价值流变更及相应的能力变更。",
